q_zh: 英軍於哪一年在香港島登陸並升起英國國旗？
q_en: In which year did British forces land on Hong Kong Island and raise the flag?
explanation_zh: 1841 年 1 月 26 日，英軍在水坑口（今上環）登陸。割讓條約其後於 1842 年簽訂。
explanation_en: On 26 January 1841 British forces landed at Possession Point (now Sheung Wan). The cession treaty came a year later, in 1842.

q_zh: 上環哪條街名紀念英軍 1841 年登陸一事？
q_en: Which Sheung Wan street name recalls the British landing of 1841?
explanation_zh: 水坑口街的英文名 Possession Street 即「佔領」之意。
explanation_en: Possession Street takes its name from 'taking possession' of the island.

q_zh: 哪份條約把香港島割讓予英國？
q_en: Which treaty ceded Hong Kong Island to Britain?
explanation_zh: 鴉片戰爭後中英簽訂《南京條約》，香港島永久割讓。
explanation_en: After the First Opium War, the Treaty of Nanking ceded Hong Kong Island in perpetuity.

q_zh: 1860 年《北京條約》割讓了哪些地方？
q_en: What did the 1860 Convention of Peking cede?
correct_zh: 九龍半島南部（界限街以南）及昂船洲
correct_en: Southern Kowloon (south of Boundary Street) and Stonecutters Island
explanation_zh: 界限街以南的九龍連昂船洲於 1860 年割讓。
explanation_en: Kowloon south of Boundary Street plus Stonecutters Island were ceded in 1860, after the Second Opium War.

q_zh: 1898 年英國向中國租借新界，租期多長？
q_en: In 1898 Britain leased the New Territories. For how long?
explanation_zh: 租約於 1997 年屆滿，是回歸談判的起點。
explanation_en: The lease ran out in 1997, which is why the sovereignty talks of the 1980s began.

q_zh: 哪些地區是「永久割讓」，哪些是「租借」？
q_en: Which areas were ceded for good and which were only leased?
correct_zh: 港島及九龍南部割讓；新界租借 99 年
correct_en: Hong Kong Island and southern Kowloon were ceded; the New Territories were leased for 99 years
wrong3_en: The island was leased; the New Territories ceded
explanation_zh: 三份條約性質不同，這是 1997 年整體交還的背景。
explanation_en: The three agreements differed in nature — the background to the whole territory returning in 1997.

q_zh: 香港第一任總督是誰？
q_en: Who was Hong Kong's first Governor?
explanation_zh: 砵甸乍於 1843 年出任首任港督。
explanation_en: Pottinger became the first Governor in 1843.

q_zh: 1839 年在虎門銷毀鴉片的欽差大臣是誰？
q_en: Which imperial commissioner destroyed seized opium at Humen in 1839?
explanation_zh: 林則徐虎門銷煙是鴉片戰爭的導火線之一。
explanation_en: Lin's destruction of the opium was a trigger of the First Opium War.

q_zh: 以英女王命名的殖民地城市「維多利亞城」位於今天哪一帶？
q_en: 'Victoria City', named after the Queen, lay in which part of today's Hong Kong?
correct_en: The north shore of Hong Kong Island (Central area)
explanation_zh: 早期英國人在港島北岸發展市區。
explanation_en: The early colonial town grew along the north shore of the island.

q_zh: 香港於 1841 年起被定位為甚麼貿易地位？
q_en: What trading status did the early colony adopt from 1841?
explanation_zh: 自由港政策奠定香港轉口貿易的基礎。
explanation_en: The free-port policy laid the foundation for Hong Kong's entrepôt trade.

q_zh: 「香港」一名一般被解作甚麼意思？
q_en: What does the name 'Hong Kong' (香港) commonly mean?
explanation_zh: 一說與莞香（香料）貿易有關。
explanation_en: One explanation links it to the incense (agarwood) trade.

q_zh: 匯豐銀行於哪一年在香港成立？
q_en: In which year was HSBC founded in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 香港上海匯豐銀行於 1865 年在港開業。
explanation_en: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation opened in Hong Kong in 1865.

q_zh: 1872 年創辦、服務華人的慈善醫院是哪一間？
q_en: Which charitable hospital for the Chinese community opened in 1872?
explanation_zh: 東華醫院是香港首間華人醫院，後來發展成東華三院。
explanation_en: Tung Wah was the first Chinese hospital and grew into the Tung Wah Group of Hospitals.

q_zh: 香港天文台於哪一年成立？
q_en: In which year was the Hong Kong Observatory founded?
explanation_zh: 天文台 1883 年成立，負責氣象與天文觀測。
explanation_en: The Observatory was founded in 1883 for meteorological and astronomical observation.

q_zh: 山頂纜車於 1888 年啟用，它是亞洲哪一類的第一條？
q_en: The Peak Tram opened in 1888. What was it the first of in Asia?
explanation_zh: 山頂纜車是亞洲最早的纜索鐵路。
explanation_en: The Peak Tram is Asia's oldest funicular railway.

q_zh: 1880 年，哪位華人成為立法局首位華人議員？
q_en: Who became the first Chinese member of the Legislative Council in 1880?
explanation_zh: 伍廷芳 1880 年獲委任為首位華人非官守議員。
explanation_en: Ng Choy was appointed the first Chinese unofficial member in 1880.

q_zh: 孫中山曾在香港哪類學院學醫？
q_en: Sun Yat-sen studied at which kind of institution in Hong Kong?
correct_en: Hong Kong College of Medicine for Chinese
explanation_zh: 孫中山 1887–1892 年於西醫書院習醫。
explanation_en: Sun studied there from 1887 to 1892.

q_zh: 1894 年香港鼠疫期間，哪位科學家在港發現鼠疫桿菌？
q_en: Which scientist identified the plague bacillus in Hong Kong in 1894?
explanation_zh: 耶爾森在港研究並發現鼠疫桿菌。
explanation_en: Yersin worked in Hong Kong and identified the bacillus.

q_zh: 1898 年條約中，九龍寨城的管轄權如何安排？
q_en: Under the 1898 convention, what was special about Kowloon Walled City?
explanation_zh: 寨城後來成為無人管轄的高密度社區，1993–94 年清拆。
explanation_en: It later became a famously dense enclave, demolished in 1993–94.

q_zh: 九廣鐵路英段（尖沙咀至羅湖）大約於哪年通車？
q_en: Roughly when did the British section of the Kowloon–Canton Railway open?
explanation_zh: 九廣鐵路英段 1910 年建成，連接廣州。
explanation_en: The British section opened in 1910, linking Kowloon with Canton.

q_zh: 哪個馬場於 1840 年代已建成？
q_en: Which racecourse dates from the 1840s?
explanation_zh: 跑馬地原是沼澤，1845 年起建馬場。
explanation_en: Happy Valley was drained swampland and the racecourse dates to 1845.

q_zh: 1841 年英軍抵達時，港島大約有多少居民？
q_en: Roughly how many people lived on Hong Kong Island when the British arrived in 1841?
correct_zh: 約 7,000 人（村民及水上人）
explanation_zh: 當時只是漁農社區，並非「一片空白的荒島」。
explanation_en: It was a community of farmers and fishers, not an empty rock.

q_zh: 第二次鴉片戰爭又稱為甚麼？
q_en: What is the Second Opium War also called?
explanation_zh: 戰爭結束於 1860 年，同年《北京條約》割讓九龍。
explanation_en: It ended in 1860, the year Kowloon was ceded.

q_zh: 1842 年《南京條約》簽署後，香港島屬於哪種地位？
q_en: After the 1842 Treaty of Nanking, what was Hong Kong Island's status?
explanation_zh: 1843 年正式成為英國殖民地，砵甸乍任首任總督。
explanation_en: It formally became a Crown colony in 1843, with Pottinger as first Governor.

q_zh: 香港大學於哪一年創辦？
q_en: In which year was the University of Hong Kong founded?
explanation_zh: 港大是香港第一所大學。
explanation_en: HKU was Hong Kong's first university.

q_zh: 1918 年跑馬地馬場大火造成大約多少人死亡？
q_en: Roughly how many people died in the 1918 Happy Valley Racecourse fire?
explanation_zh: 這是香港史上最嚴重的火災之一。
explanation_en: It remains one of the deadliest fires in Hong Kong's history.

q_zh: 1906 年「丙午風災」估計奪去多少性命？
q_en: How many lives did the great typhoon of 1906 reportedly claim?
explanation_zh: 1906 年 9 月的颱風令港口損失慘重。
explanation_en: The September 1906 typhoon devastated the harbour.

q_zh: 1913 年的《莊子試妻》被視為甚麼？
q_en: The 1913 film 'Zhuangzi Tests His Wife' is regarded as what?
correct_zh: 香港首部本地製作的劇情短片
correct_en: Regarded as Hong Kong's first locally made story film
explanation_zh: 黎民偉被稱為「香港電影之父」。
explanation_en: Lai Man-wai is called the father of Hong Kong cinema.

q_zh: 1925–26 年的省港大罷工大約持續多久？
q_en: About how long did the 1925–26 Canton–Hong Kong strike last?
explanation_zh: 大批工人離港返內地，令香港經濟受挫。
explanation_en: Many workers left for the mainland, hitting the economy hard.

q_zh: 「啟德」機場的名字源自哪兩個人？
q_en: Kai Tak Airport's name comes from which two men?
wrong1_en: Robert Ho Tung and Robert Kotewall
explanation_zh: 兩人合組公司開發啟德濱。
explanation_en: They formed the Kai Tak Bund company that reclaimed the area.

q_zh: 1904 年《山頂區保留條例》的影響是甚麼？
q_en: What did the 1904 Peak Reservation Ordinance do?
correct_zh: 限制華人在山頂居住（1946 年廢除）
correct_en: Barred most Chinese from living on the Peak (repealed in 1946)
wrong3_en: Gave free homes to Chinese residents
explanation_zh: 這是殖民地種族隔離的例子。
explanation_en: It is an example of colonial racial segregation.

q_zh: 日軍進攻香港發生在哪一天？
q_en: On what date did Japan attack Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 與偷襲珍珠港同日（香港時間）。
explanation_en: The same day as Pearl Harbor (Hong Kong time).

q_zh: 港督楊慕琦何時向日軍投降？
q_en: When did Governor Mark Young surrender to Japan?
explanation_zh: 這天被稱為「黑色聖誕」。
explanation_en: The day is remembered as 'Black Christmas'.

q_zh: 日佔時期共持續多久？
q_en: How long did the Japanese occupation last?
explanation_en: From 25 December 1941 to 15 August 1945.

q_zh: 日佔時期強迫流通的貨幣俗稱甚麼？
q_en: What was the forced Japanese occupation currency nicknamed?
explanation_zh: 軍票毫無信用，百姓生活極度困苦。
explanation_en: The notes were worthless and caused terrible hardship.

q_zh: 在日佔時期協助盟軍戰俘逃出香港的是哪個組織？
q_en: Which group helped Allied prisoners escape Hong Kong during the occupation?
wrong1_en: A Hong Kong police special unit
explanation_zh: 創辦人是港大教授賴廉士（Lindsay Ride）。
explanation_en: It was founded by HKU professor Lindsay Ride.

q_zh: 日佔時期被拘禁的外籍平民主要集中在哪裏？
q_en: Where were most Allied civilians interned during the occupation?
explanation_zh: 戰俘則多囚於深水埗等營。
explanation_en: Prisoners of war were mostly held at Sham Shui Po and other camps.

q_zh: 1941 年有哪個國家的部隊來港參與守衛戰？
q_en: Troops from which country joined the 1941 defence of Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 加拿大「C 部隊」於 1941 年 11 月抵港。
explanation_en: Canada's 'C Force' arrived in November 1941.

q_zh: 1945 年日本投降後，由誰代表英國在港接受日軍投降？
q_en: Who accepted the Japanese surrender in Hong Kong on Britain's behalf in 1945?
explanation_zh: 夏慤 1945 年 9 月 16 日在港督府主持受降。
explanation_en: Harcourt presided over the surrender at Government House on 16 September 1945.

q_zh: 1945 年戰爭結束時，香港人口大約剩多少？
q_en: Roughly what was Hong Kong's population when the war ended in 1945?
explanation_zh: 飢荒與遷離令人口由約 160 萬大減。
explanation_en: Starvation and departures cut it from about 1.6 million.

q_zh: 1946 年港督楊慕琦提出的「楊慕琦計劃」是甚麼？
q_en: What was the 1946 'Young Plan'?
correct_zh: 設立由市民選出的市議會的政制改革
correct_en: A reform proposing an elected municipal council
explanation_zh: 計劃於 1952 年擱置。
explanation_en: The plan was shelved in 1952.

q_zh: 1949 年哪件大事令大批難民湧入香港？
q_en: Which event in 1949 sent large numbers of refugees to Hong Kong?
correct_zh: 中國內戰結束、新政權成立
correct_en: The end of the Chinese Civil War
wrong1_en: The start of World War II
explanation_zh: 人口在數年間急增，為戰後發展奠基。
explanation_en: The population surged, shaping postwar Hong Kong.

q_zh: 國泰航空於哪一年成立？
q_en: In which year was Cathay Pacific founded?
explanation_zh: 由美籍及澳洲籍飛行員創辦。
explanation_en: It was founded by an American and an Australian pilot.

q_zh: 電車（叮叮）在港島通車始於哪一年？
q_en: In which year did trams ('Ding Ding') start running on Hong Kong Island?
explanation_zh: 香港電車至今仍在運行。
explanation_en: Hong Kong's trams are still running today.

q_zh: 1937 年爆發的哪場戰爭，令大批內地人逃來香港？
q_en: Which war that began in 1937 pushed many mainlanders to flee to Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 到 1941 年人口已超過 150 萬。
explanation_en: By 1941 the population exceeded 1.5 million.

q_zh: 尖沙咀鐘樓原屬哪個舊建築？
q_en: The Tsim Sha Tsui Clock Tower belonged to which old building?
explanation_zh: 鐘樓建於 1915 年，是歷史地標。
explanation_en: Built in 1915, it is a heritage landmark.

q_zh: 1946 年香港重光後，民政管治由誰恢復？
q_en: Who restored civil government in Hong Kong in 1946?
explanation_zh: 1946 年 5 月恢復文官政府。
explanation_en: Civil government was restored in May 1946.

q_zh: 1941 年日軍進攻前，駐港部隊中有哪個本地志願組織？
q_en: Which local volunteer force fought alongside the garrison in 1941?
explanation_zh: 成員包括多個族裔的香港居民。
explanation_en: Its members came from many communities.

q_zh: 哪場大火促成香港大規模公共房屋計劃？
q_en: Which fire led to Hong Kong's large-scale public housing programme?
explanation_zh: 大火令逾五萬人無家可歸，政府開始興建徙置大廈。
explanation_en: Over 50,000 lost their homes and the government began building resettlement blocks.

q_zh: 石硤尾大火發生在哪一天？
q_en: On what day did the Shek Kip Mei fire happen?
explanation_zh: 火災發生於 1953 年 12 月 25 日。
explanation_en: The fire broke out on 25 December 1953.

q_zh: 早期徙置大廈的居住環境通常如何？
q_en: What were early resettlement blocks typically like?
correct_zh: 一家人一個小單位，共用廁所與水龍頭
correct_en: One small room per family, with shared toilets and water taps
explanation_zh: 這些屋邨是後來公屋制度的前身。
explanation_en: They were the forerunners of today's public rental housing.

q_zh: 1950 年代初，哪個外部因素令香港由轉口貿易轉向製造業？
q_en: Which external factor pushed Hong Kong from entrepôt trade towards manufacturing in the early 1950s?
correct_zh: 韓戰期間對中國的禁運
correct_en: The embargo on China during the Korean War
explanation_zh: 轉口貿易萎縮，工業取而代之。
explanation_en: Entrepôt trade shrank and industry took its place.

q_zh: 哪個城市的實業家南下，為香港紡織業帶來資金與技術？
q_en: Industrialists from which city brought capital and skills to Hong Kong's textile industry?
explanation_zh: 上海紗廠老闆與工人是香港工業起飛的關鍵。
explanation_en: Shanghai mill owners and workers were key to Hong Kong's industrial take-off.

q_zh: 1960 年代香港著名的出口貨品之一是甚麼？
q_en: Which product was a famous Hong Kong export of the 1960s?
explanation_zh: 塑膠花、玩具、成衣令香港有「世界工廠」之稱。
explanation_en: Plastic flowers, toys and garments earned Hong Kong a 'world factory' reputation.

q_zh: 1956 年「雙十暴動」的導火線是甚麼？
q_en: What triggered the 1956 'Double Ten' riots?
correct_zh: 國慶日（十月十日）旗幟與親國民黨／親共雙方衝突
correct_en: Clashes over flags on 10 October between pro-Nationalist and pro-Communist groups
explanation_zh: 事件發生於荃灣等地的徙置區。
explanation_en: It began at resettlement estates such as Tsuen Wan.

q_zh: 1966 年「天星小輪加價事件」中，加價幅度大約是多少？
q_en: How big was the fare rise behind the 1966 Star Ferry disturbances?
correct_en: Five cents on the first-class fare
explanation_zh: 加幅雖小，卻觸發市民對社會不滿。
explanation_en: A small rise, but it sparked wider social discontent.

q_zh: 1966 年因天星加價而絕食抗議的是誰？
q_en: Who staged a hunger strike against the 1966 Star Ferry fare rise?
explanation_zh: 他的絕食被捕後，引發數日騷亂。
explanation_en: His arrest sparked several days of disturbances.

q_zh: 1967 年暴動由哪裏的勞資糾紛引發？
q_en: Where did the labour dispute that triggered the 1967 riots begin?
correct_en: A plastic flower factory in San Po Kong
explanation_zh: 勞資糾紛於 1967 年 5 月升級。
explanation_en: The dispute escalated in May 1967.

q_zh: 1967 年暴動受到內地哪場運動影響？
q_en: The 1967 riots were influenced by which mainland movement?
explanation_zh: 左派發動「反英抗暴」，並使用炸彈。
explanation_en: Leftists launched an 'anti-British' campaign that included bombings.

q_zh: 1967 年被燒死的商業電台節目主持人是誰？
q_en: Which Commercial Radio host was killed in August 1967?
explanation_zh: 事件震驚社會，市民對暴力反感。
explanation_en: The killing shocked the public and turned many against the violence.

q_zh: 1967 年暴動後，殖民政府的主要反應是甚麼？
q_en: What was the colonial government's main response after the 1967 riots?
correct_zh: 推行勞工、房屋、教育等社會改革
correct_en: Social reforms on labour, housing and education
explanation_zh: 改革在 1970 年代由麥理浩大力推動。
explanation_en: Reforms were pushed hard in the 1970s under MacLehose.

q_zh: 無綫電視（TVB）於哪一年啟播？
q_en: In which year did TVB begin broadcasting?
explanation_zh: TVB 是香港首間免費電視台。
explanation_en: TVB was Hong Kong's first free-to-air TV station.

q_zh: 1957 年香港首個電視服務是甚麼？
q_en: What was Hong Kong's first television service in 1957?
explanation_zh: 麗的映聲後來演變為亞洲電視。
explanation_en: Rediffusion later became ATV.

q_zh: 1962 年襲港並造成約 130 人死亡的颱風是？
q_en: Which typhoon hit in 1962 and killed about 130 people?
explanation_zh: 溫黛是香港史上最致命颱風之一。
explanation_en: Wanda is among the deadliest typhoons on record.

q_zh: 哪個地區於 1959 年被定為香港首個新市鎮？
q_en: Which district was designated Hong Kong's first new town in 1959?
explanation_zh: 新市鎮政策疏導市區人口。
explanation_en: New towns were meant to relieve urban crowding.

q_zh: 1961 年在清水灣建成電影城的是哪家公司？
q_en: Which company built its Clearwater Bay film studio in 1961?
explanation_zh: 邵氏影城產出大量功夫與歌唱片。
explanation_en: Shaw's studio turned out many kung fu and musical films.

q_zh: 獅子山隧道於哪一年通車？
q_en: In which year did the Lion Rock Tunnel open?
explanation_zh: 隧道連接九龍與沙田。
explanation_en: It links Kowloon with Sha Tin.

q_zh: 香港、新加坡、南韓與台灣在當年被合稱為甚麼？
q_en: Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan were collectively called what?
explanation_zh: 四地以出口帶動高速增長。
explanation_en: All four grew rapidly on export-led growth.

q_zh: 1960 年代財政司郝德傑奉行的是哪種經濟理念？
q_en: Which economic approach did 1960s Financial Secretary John Cowperthwaite champion?
explanation_zh: 低稅、小政府成為香港經濟特色。
explanation_en: Low taxes and small government became Hong Kong's hallmark.

q_zh: 1960 年代港元與哪種貨幣掛鈎？
q_en: In the 1960s the Hong Kong dollar was tied to which currency?
explanation_zh: 港元 1972 年起改與美元掛鈎。
explanation_en: The link shifted from sterling to the US dollar in 1972.

q_zh: 港督在殖民地時期由誰委任？
q_en: In colonial times, who appointed the Governor of Hong Kong?
wrong1_en: A vote by Hong Kong citizens
explanation_zh: 因此港人沒有選舉港督的權利。
explanation_en: Hong Kong people therefore had no vote on their governor.

q_zh: 1965 年擠提風潮後，誰入股收購恒生銀行？
q_en: After the 1965 bank run, who bought a controlling stake in Hang Seng Bank?
explanation_zh: 匯豐於 1965 年取得恒生 51% 股權。
explanation_en: HSBC acquired 51% of Hang Seng in 1965.

q_zh: 麥理浩出任港督的年份是？
q_en: In which year did Murray MacLehose become Governor?
explanation_zh: 他任期至 1982 年，推動十年建屋、廉政公署等改革。
explanation_en: He served until 1982 and drove housing, anti-corruption and other reforms.

q_zh: 1971 年 7 月在維多利亞公園舉行的大型集會與哪件事有關？
q_en: A large July 1971 rally at Victoria Park was about which issue?
explanation_zh: 警方曾以警棍驅散人群。
explanation_en: Police used batons to disperse the crowd.

q_zh: 1971 年聯合國通過第 2758 號決議，結果是甚麼？
q_en: What did UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 (1971) decide?
correct_zh: 由中華人民共和國取代中華民國代表中國
correct_en: The PRC replaced the ROC as China's representative
wrong1_en: Hong Kong became a member state
wrong3_en: The UN moved to Hong Kong
explanation_zh: 決議為翌年處理香港地位鋪路。
explanation_en: It paved the way for the 1972 move on Hong Kong's status.

q_zh: 1972 年 11 月，聯合國大會通過把香港與澳門從甚麼名單中剔除？
q_en: In November 1972 the UN General Assembly removed Hong Kong and Macau from which list?
correct_zh: 殖民地（非自治領土）名單
explanation_zh: 這是應中華人民共和國要求作出的決議（第 2908 號）。
explanation_en: The vote (Resolution 2908) followed a request from the PRC.

q_zh: 1972 年除名的實際影響之一是甚麼？
q_en: What was one practical effect of the 1972 removal?
correct_zh: 香港不再列入聯合國去殖民化議程
correct_en: Hong Kong was no longer on the UN decolonisation agenda
wrong1_en: Hong Kong returned to China at once
wrong3_en: Hong Kong got its own UN seat
explanation_zh: 批評者認為這令香港人少了一條自決途徑。
explanation_en: Critics argue it removed one route to self-determination.

q_zh: 香港第一條過海行車隧道於哪一年通車？
q_en: In which year did the first cross-harbour road tunnel open?
explanation_zh: 紅磡海底隧道連接九龍與港島。
explanation_en: The Cross-Harbour Tunnel links Kowloon and Hong Kong Island.

q_zh: 哪宗事件促成 1974 年廉政公署成立？
q_en: Which case led to the founding of the ICAC in 1974?
correct_zh: 總警司葛柏潛逃回英國
correct_en: Chief Superintendent Peter Godber's flight to Britain
explanation_zh: 葛柏案令市民對貪污忍無可忍。
explanation_en: The Godber case outraged the public over corruption.

q_zh: 廉政公署首任專員是誰？
q_en: Who was the ICAC's first Commissioner?
explanation_zh: 姬達 1974 年出任首任廉政專員。
explanation_en: Cater took the post in 1974.

q_zh: 1977 年麥理浩宣布了甚麼措施以平息警隊風波？
q_en: What did MacLehose announce in 1977 to settle the police unrest over the ICAC?
correct_zh: 對 1977 年前的貪污罪行實施特赦
correct_en: An amnesty for pre-1977 corruption offences
explanation_zh: 廉署其後繼續追查，建立公信力。
explanation_en: The ICAC continued and built its credibility.

q_zh: 1973–74 年股災，恒生指數大約下跌多少？
q_en: Roughly how much did the Hang Seng Index fall in the 1973–74 crash?
explanation_zh: 指數由約 1,775 點跌至約 150 點。
explanation_en: It fell from about 1,775 points to about 150.

q_zh: 香港何時開始實施九年免費強迫教育？
q_en: When did nine years of free, compulsory education begin?
explanation_zh: 1971 年先有六年免費小學。
explanation_en: Free primary education (six years) came first, in 1971.

q_zh: 香港地鐵首段（觀塘至石硤尾）通車於哪一年？
q_en: In which year did the first MTR section (Kwun Tong to Shek Kip Mei) open?
explanation_zh: 地鐵 1979 年 9 月 30 日首次通車。
explanation_en: The first trains ran on 30 September 1979.

q_zh: 1975 年起大量抵港的越南難民俗稱甚麼？
q_en: What were the Vietnamese refugees who arrived from 1975 commonly called?
explanation_zh: 香港曾設多個難民營收容。
explanation_en: Hong Kong ran numerous camps for them.

q_zh: 李小龍的《龍爭虎鬥》於哪一年上映？
q_en: In which year was Bruce Lee's 'Enter the Dragon' released?
explanation_zh: 李小龍同年 7 月 20 日逝世，年僅 32 歲。
explanation_en: Lee died on 20 July the same year, aged 32.

q_zh: 1980 年廢除的「抵壘政策」是指甚麼？
q_en: What was the 'touch-base policy' abolished in 1980?
correct_zh: 非法入境者抵達市區即可居留
correct_en: Illegal immigrants who reached the urban area could stay
explanation_zh: 1980 年 10 月 24 日起，抵港者一律被遣返。
explanation_en: From 24 October 1980 new arrivals were repatriated.

q_zh: 1979 年麥理浩訪京，鄧小平請他轉告港人甚麼？
q_en: What did Deng Xiaoping tell MacLehose in 1979 to pass on to Hong Kong investors?
explanation_zh: 鄧小平以此安撫投資者。
explanation_en: Deng used it to reassure investors.

q_zh: 1982 年與鄧小平會面、討論香港前途的英國首相是誰？
q_en: Which British Prime Minister met Deng Xiaoping in 1982 on Hong Kong's future?
explanation_zh: 她離開人民大會堂時在台階跌倒，成為著名畫面。
explanation_en: She famously stumbled on the steps of the Great Hall of the People.

q_zh: 1983 年港元與美元掛鈎的匯率約為多少？
q_en: At roughly what rate was the Hong Kong dollar linked to the US dollar in 1983?
correct_zh: 約 7.8 港元兌 1 美元
wrong1_zh: 約 1 港元兌 1 美元
wrong2_zh: 約 78 港元兌 1 美元
wrong3_zh: 約 0.78 港元兌 1 美元
explanation_zh: 「黑色星期六」後，政府於 10 月 17 日推出聯繫匯率。
explanation_en: After 'Black Saturday' the link was introduced on 17 October.

q_zh: 1980 年無綫電視劇集《上海灘》由誰主演？
q_en: Who starred in TVB's 1980 drama 'The Bund'?
explanation_zh: 主題曲與劇集風靡全港。
explanation_en: The series and its theme song swept the city.

q_zh: 1978 年推出的「居者有其屋計劃」目的是甚麼？
q_en: What was the Home Ownership Scheme launched in 1978 for?
correct_zh: 協助中等收入家庭買樓
explanation_zh: 配合公屋，擴大置業階梯。
explanation_en: It widened the housing ladder alongside public rental flats.

q_zh: 1987 年 10 月全球股災期間，香港聯交所停市幾天？
q_en: How many days did the Hong Kong stock exchange close during the October 1987 crash?
explanation_zh: 復市當日恒指大跌約三分之一。
explanation_en: On reopening, the index fell by about a third.

q_zh: 1982 年首次引入的選舉是甚麼？
q_en: Which elections were first introduced in 1982?
explanation_zh: 這是首批區議會選舉。
explanation_en: These were the first elections to the new District Boards.

q_zh: 1979 年《獅子山下》主題曲由誰主唱？
q_en: Who sang the 1979 theme song 'Below the Lion Rock'?
explanation_zh: 歌曲後來成為「獅子山精神」的象徵。
explanation_en: The song became a symbol of the 'Lion Rock Spirit'.

q_zh: 1970 年代香港流行的粵語電視劇與電影，常以甚麼為主題？
q_en: What did many 1970s Cantonese TV dramas and films show about Hong Kong?
correct_zh: 草根奮鬥與「打工仔」生活
correct_en: Grassroots struggle and ordinary working life
explanation_zh: 與「獅子山精神」互相呼應。
explanation_en: It echoed the 'Lion Rock Spirit'.

q_zh: 新界租約於哪年屆滿，成為談判背景？
q_en: In which year did the New Territories lease expire, setting the talks in motion?
explanation_zh: 1997 年 6 月 30 日午夜屆滿。
explanation_en: It ran out at midnight on 30 June 1997.

q_zh: 《中英聯合聲明》簽署於哪一年？
q_en: In which year was the Sino-British Joint Declaration signed?
explanation_zh: 1984 年 12 月 19 日在北京簽署。
explanation_en: Signed in Beijing on 19 December 1984.

q_zh: 《聯合聲明》由哪兩位領導人簽署？
q_en: Which two leaders signed the Joint Declaration?
explanation_zh: 趙紫陽當時是國務院總理。
explanation_en: Zhao was then Premier of the State Council.

q_zh: 《聯合聲明》於哪裏登記為國際條約？
q_en: With which body was the Joint Declaration registered as a treaty?
explanation_zh: 雙方 1985 年 6 月在聯合國登記。
explanation_en: It was registered at the UN in June 1985.

q_zh: 《聯合聲明》承諾香港的資本主義制度和生活方式維持多久不變？
q_en: For how long did the Joint Declaration promise HK's capitalist system and way of life would remain unchanged?
explanation_zh: 《基本法》第五條寫明五十年不變。
explanation_en: Article 5 of the Basic Law repeats the 50-year promise.

q_zh: 以下哪項是《聯合聲明》的承諾？
q_en: Which of these was a promise made in the Joint Declaration?
correct_zh: 香港享有除外交與國防外的高度自治
correct_en: A high degree of autonomy except in foreign and defence affairs
wrong1_zh: 香港成為廣東省的一個市
wrong1_en: Hong Kong becomes a city in Guangdong
wrong2_zh: 內地法律取代香港法律
wrong2_en: Mainland law replaces Hong Kong law
explanation_zh: 「港人治港、高度自治」是核心承諾。
explanation_en: 'Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong' was the core promise.

q_zh: 在中英談判中，香港市民的代表席位如何？
q_en: In the Sino-British talks, what seat did Hong Kong people have?
correct_zh: 沒有，談判只由中英雙方進行
correct_en: None — only Beijing and London negotiated
explanation_zh: 中方拒絕「三腳凳」模式。
explanation_en: Beijing rejected the 'three-legged stool' idea.

q_zh: 《基本法》於哪一年頒布？
q_en: In which year was the Basic Law promulgated?
explanation_zh: 1990 年 4 月 4 日頒布，1997 年 7 月 1 日實施。
explanation_en: Promulgated 4 April 1990, effective 1 July 1997.

q_zh: 《基本法》第四十五條的「最終目標」是甚麼？
q_en: What is the 'ultimate aim' stated in Article 45 of the Basic Law?
correct_en: Selecting the Chief Executive by universal suffrage
wrong1_zh: 行政長官由英女王任命
wrong1_en: The Queen appoints the Chief Executive
explanation_zh: 須經廣泛代表性的提名委員會提名。
explanation_en: Upon nomination by a broadly representative nominating committee.

q_zh: 《基本法》第六十八條的最終目標是甚麼？
q_en: What does Article 68 of the Basic Law set as the ultimate aim?
correct_zh: 立法會全部議員由普選產生
correct_en: All Legislative Council members elected by universal suffrage
wrong1_zh: 立法會由行政長官委任
wrong1_en: LegCo appointed by the Chief Executive
explanation_zh: 兩條條文成為日後爭取普選的法律依據。
explanation_en: These two articles became the legal basis of later calls for universal suffrage.

q_zh: 1991 年首次立法局直選共有多少個直選議席？
q_en: How many directly elected seats were there in the first LegCo direct election of 1991?
explanation_zh: 當時立法局共 60 席。
explanation_en: The Council then had 60 seats.

q_zh: 1991 年立法局直選中，哪個政黨取得最多議席？
q_en: Which party won the most directly elected seats in 1991?
explanation_zh: 港同盟由李柱銘等人創立，後來併入民主黨。
explanation_en: It was led by Martin Lee and later merged into the Democratic Party.

q_zh: 末代港督彭定康於哪一年到任？
q_en: In which year did the last Governor, Chris Patten, take office?
explanation_zh: 他推行擴大選舉成分的政改。
explanation_en: He pushed an expansion of elected representation.

q_zh: 中方為抗衡彭定康政改而成立了甚麼機構？
q_en: What body did Beijing set up in response to the Patten reforms?
explanation_zh: 1996 年底在深圳選出，與原有立法局「另起爐灶」。
explanation_en: Chosen in Shenzhen in late 1996, it replaced the sitting council in a 'second stove' approach.

q_zh: 1987 年英國推出的 BN(O) 護照是給誰的？
q_en: Who was the BN(O) passport, introduced in 1987, for?
correct_en: British Dependent Territories citizens in Hong Kong
explanation_zh: 持有人享有領事保護，但無居英權。
explanation_en: Holders get consular protection but no right of abode in Britain.

q_zh: 1990 年英國「居英權計劃」大約給多少戶主及家人英國公民身份？
q_en: How many heads of household were offered British citizenship under the 1990 scheme?
explanation_zh: 目的是穩定六四後的人心與專業人才。
explanation_en: It aimed to steady confidence and keep skilled people after June 4.

q_zh: 1989 年港督衞奕信宣布的「玫瑰園計劃」是甚麼？
q_en: What was the 'Rose Garden Project' announced by Governor Wilson in 1989?
correct_zh: 興建新機場及相關基建
correct_en: Building a new airport and related infrastructure
explanation_zh: 計劃旨在六四後重建信心，帶來赤鱲角機場。
explanation_en: It aimed to restore confidence after June 4 and produced the Chek Lap Kok airport.

q_zh: 九龍寨城的清拆大約於哪段時間進行？
q_en: When was Kowloon Walled City demolished?
explanation_zh: 原址後來建成九龍寨城公園。
explanation_en: The site became Kowloon Walled City Park.

q_zh: 中英聯合聯絡小組的任務是甚麼？
q_en: What was the role of the Sino-British Joint Liaison Group?
correct_zh: 落實《聯合聲明》及過渡期事務
correct_en: To implement the Joint Declaration and handle transition matters
explanation_en: It operated from 1985 to 2000.

q_zh: 首任行政長官董建華由哪個機構於 1996 年選出？
q_en: Which body chose the first Chief Executive, Tung Chee-hwa, in 1996?
explanation_zh: 推選委員會 1996 年 12 月投票。
explanation_en: The committee voted in December 1996.

q_zh: 哪位港督 1986 年在北京任內逝世？
q_en: Which Governor died in office in Beijing in 1986?
explanation_zh: 尤德出任港督前曾任英國駐華大使。
explanation_en: Youde had been Britain's ambassador to China before becoming Governor.

q_zh: 鄧小平曾以哪句話形容回歸後港人生活不變？
q_en: Which phrase did Deng Xiaoping use to describe life after the handover?
correct_en: 'Horses will still run, dancing will still go on'
explanation_zh: 他以此強調生活方式不變。
explanation_en: He used it to stress an unchanged way of life.

q_zh: 英國為何在 1982 年起與中國商討香港前途？
q_en: Why did Britain begin talks with China on Hong Kong's future in 1982?
correct_zh: 新界租約將於 1997 年屆滿
correct_en: The New Territories lease would expire in 1997
explanation_zh: 租約屆滿令整體管治面臨不確定。
explanation_en: Expiry raised uncertainty over the whole territory.

q_zh: 中英談判期間，1983 年 9 月的「黑色星期六」是甚麼？
q_en: What was 'Black Saturday' of September 1983?
correct_zh: 港元急跌、市民搶購物資
correct_en: The HK dollar plunged and people stocked up on goods
explanation_zh: 政府其後於 10 月推出聯繫匯率。
explanation_en: The government introduced the linked rate that October.

q_zh: 1989 年哪位中共領導人逝世，引發北京悼念與示威？
q_en: Whose death in April 1989 sparked mourning and protests in Beijing?
explanation_zh: 胡耀邦於 4 月 15 日逝世。
explanation_en: Hu died on 15 April 1989.

q_zh: 六四事件發生於哪一個廣場附近？
q_en: Near which square did the June 4 crackdown take place?
explanation_zh: 軍隊於 6 月 3 日晚至 4 日清晨進城清場。
explanation_en: Troops moved in on the night of 3–4 June.

q_zh: 1989 年 5 月，香港大約有多少人上街聲援北京學生？
q_en: About how many Hong Kong people marched in support of Beijing's students in May 1989?
explanation_zh: 相當於當時約五分之一人口。
explanation_en: Roughly one in five residents at the time.

q_zh: 1989 年成立的「香港市民支援愛國民主運動聯合會」簡稱？
q_en: What is the short name of the group founded in 1989 as the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China?
explanation_zh: 首任主席是司徒華。
explanation_en: Its first chairman was Szeto Wah.

q_zh: 1989 年 5 月 27 日在跑馬地馬場舉行的籌款活動叫甚麼？
q_en: What was the 27 May 1989 fundraising event at Happy Valley Racecourse called?
explanation_zh: 多位歌手參加，現場數十萬人。
explanation_en: Many singers took part before a crowd of hundreds of thousands.

q_zh: 維多利亞公園燭光悼念晚會自哪一年起每年舉行？
q_en: From which year was the Victoria Park candlelight vigil held annually?
explanation_zh: 首屆於 1990 年 6 月 4 日舉行。
explanation_en: The first was on 4 June 1990.

q_zh: 「黃雀行動」是甚麼？
q_en: What was 'Operation Yellowbird'?
correct_zh: 協助六四後被通緝人士經香港逃走的行動
correct_en: A network that helped wanted dissidents escape through Hong Kong after June 4
explanation_zh: 行動由香港多方人士參與。
explanation_en: Many Hong Kong people took part.

q_zh: 「國殤之柱」雕塑家來自哪國？
q_en: The sculptor of the 'Pillar of Shame' came from which country?
explanation_zh: 高志活（Jens Galschiøt）創作，1997 年起在港展出。
explanation_en: Created by Jens Galschiøt and shown in Hong Kong from 1997.

q_zh: 「國殤之柱」於 2021 年 12 月從哪所大學移走？
q_en: From which university was the 'Pillar of Shame' removed in December 2021?
explanation_zh: 港大要求移走雕塑。
explanation_en: HKU had demanded its removal.

q_zh: 以下哪兩位基本法起草委員會成員，因批評鎮壓而被取消資格？
q_en: Which two Basic Law drafters were removed after criticising the crackdown?
explanation_zh: 兩人 1989 年被中方取消草委資格。
explanation_en: Beijing stripped both of their drafting roles in 1989.

q_zh: 六四後香港出現甚麼社會現象？
q_en: What social trend followed June 4 in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 很多人移民加拿大、澳洲、英國。
explanation_en: Many left for Canada, Australia and Britain.

q_zh: 「今日北京，明日香港」這句口號反映的是甚麼？
q_en: What did the slogan 'Beijing today, Hong Kong tomorrow' express?
correct_zh: 港人對 1997 年後前景的憂慮
correct_en: Hong Kong people's fears about their post-1997 future
explanation_zh: 口號出現於 1989 年的遊行。
explanation_en: It appeared in the marches of 1989.

q_zh: 「坦克人」指的是甚麼？
q_en: What does 'Tank Man' refer to?
correct_zh: 一名在長安街獨自擋住坦克隊的男子
correct_en: A man who stood alone in front of a tank column on Chang'an Avenue
explanation_zh: 影像在 6 月 5 日被多名攝影師拍下。
explanation_en: Several photographers captured him on 5 June.

q_zh: 趙紫陽六四後遭遇如何？
q_en: What happened to Zhao Ziyang after June 4?
correct_zh: 被撤職並軟禁，至 2005 年逝世
correct_en: He was removed and kept under house arrest until his death in 2005
explanation_zh: 他曾探望絕食學生。
explanation_en: He had visited the hunger-striking students.

q_zh: 「民主女神像」是甚麼？
q_en: What was the 'Goddess of Democracy'?
correct_zh: 學生於天安門廣場豎立的約十米高雕像
correct_en: A roughly ten-metre statue erected by students in Tiananmen Square
explanation_zh: 雕像 1989 年 5 月 30 日豎立。
explanation_en: It was erected on 30 May 1989.

q_zh: 「天安門母親」是指甚麼群體？
q_en: Who are the 'Tiananmen Mothers'?
correct_zh: 六四死難者的家屬，追求真相與問責
correct_en: Relatives of victims who seek truth and accountability
explanation_zh: 發起人丁子霖的兒子在六四遇害。
explanation_en: Founder Ding Zilin lost her son in the crackdown.

q_zh: 以下哪位是 1989 年北京學生領袖？
q_en: Which of these was a 1989 Beijing student leader?
explanation_zh: 王丹是最知名的學生領袖之一。
explanation_en: Wang Dan was among the best-known student leaders.

q_zh: 2020 年六四晚會被警方禁止，理由是？
q_en: In 2020 police banned the vigil, citing what reason?
explanation_zh: 這是維園晚會 30 年來首次被禁。
explanation_en: It was the first ban in 30 years.

q_zh: 支聯會在哪年表決解散？
q_en: In which year did the Hong Kong Alliance vote to disband?
explanation_zh: 解散於 2021 年 9 月。
explanation_en: The vote came in September 2021.

q_zh: 《基本法》第二十三條在六四後的草擬中增加了甚麼？
q_en: What was added to Basic Law Article 23 in its drafting after June 4?
correct_zh: 禁止顛覆中央政府及外國政治組織在港活動
correct_en: Bans on subversion of the central government and on foreign political organisations' activities
explanation_zh: 文本在 1989 年收緊。
explanation_en: The text was tightened in 1989.

q_zh: 六四紀念館於哪一年在尖沙咀開幕？
q_en: In which year did the June 4 Museum open in Tsim Sha Tsui?
explanation_zh: 紀念館由支聯會營運，於 2021 年關閉。
explanation_en: Run by the Alliance, it closed in 2021.

q_zh: 1989 年 6 月 4 日是星期幾？
q_en: On which day of the week was 4 June 1989?
explanation_zh: 當時是星期日，香港市民大規模悼念。
explanation_en: It was a Sunday; Hong Kong held mass mourning.

q_zh: 香港市民於六四後的主要行動是下列哪項？
q_en: Which of these was a major Hong Kong response after June 4?
correct_en: Marches, rallies, silent tributes and fundraising
explanation_zh: 大量市民參與悼念與捐款。
explanation_en: Huge numbers joined the mourning and donated.

q_zh: 香港大專學生在六四後作出哪類行動？
q_en: What did Hong Kong students do after June 4?
explanation_zh: 各大專院校均有悼念活動。
explanation_en: Campuses across Hong Kong held tributes.

q_zh: 香港主權移交儀式在哪一天舉行？
q_en: On what date did the handover of sovereignty take place?
explanation_zh: 香港由英國交還中國。
explanation_en: Hong Kong passed from Britain to China.

q_zh: 回歸儀式當晚的天氣如何？
q_en: What was the weather like during the handover ceremony?
explanation_zh: 「九七回歸那晚落雨」成為港人共同記憶。
explanation_en: 'It rained that night' became a shared Hong Kong memory.

q_zh: 香港末代總督是誰？
q_en: Who was Hong Kong's last Governor?
explanation_zh: 彭定康與查爾斯王子乘「不列顛尼亞號」離港。
explanation_en: Patten and Prince Charles left aboard HMY Britannia.

q_zh: 首任行政長官是誰？
q_en: Who was the first Chief Executive?
explanation_en: Tung served 1997–2005.

q_zh: 回歸後香港防務由哪支部隊負責？
q_en: Which force took over Hong Kong's defence after the handover?
correct_zh: 中國人民解放軍駐港部隊
explanation_zh: 《基本法》規定外交與國防由中央負責。
explanation_en: The Basic Law gives the central government foreign affairs and defence.

q_zh: 特區區旗與區徽上的花是甚麼？
q_en: Which flower appears on the SAR flag and emblem?
explanation_zh: 洋紫荊是香港市花。
explanation_en: Bauhinia is Hong Kong's floral emblem.

q_zh: 八達通卡於哪一年推出？
q_en: In which year was the Octopus card launched?
explanation_zh: 1997 年 9 月啟用。
explanation_en: It launched in September 1997.

q_zh: 1997 年中爆發的哪場危機衝擊香港？
q_en: Which crisis, beginning in mid-1997, hit Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 港元受衝擊，樓價與股市大跌。
explanation_en: The HK dollar was attacked and property and stocks fell.

q_zh: 1998 年 8 月，政府為捍衞港元入市買了甚麼？
q_en: In August 1998 the government intervened to defend the currency by buying what?
explanation_zh: 入市金額約 1,180 億港元。
explanation_en: The intervention was worth about HK$118 billion.

q_zh: 赤鱲角新機場於哪一年啟用？
q_en: In which year did the Chek Lap Kok airport open?
explanation_zh: 啟德機場同日關閉。
explanation_en: Kai Tak closed that same day.

q_zh: 1997 年底為遏止哪種疫症而撲殺大批雞隻？
q_en: Which disease led to a mass poultry cull at the end of 1997?
explanation_zh: 約 130 萬隻雞被撲殺。
explanation_en: About 1.3 million birds were culled.

q_zh: 2003 年沙士在香港造成約多少人死亡？
q_en: About how many people died of SARS in Hong Kong in 2003?
explanation_zh: 本港共有 1,755 宗確診，299 人死亡。
explanation_en: Hong Kong had 1,755 cases and 299 deaths.

q_zh: 沙士期間哪個屋苑爆發大規模群組感染？
q_en: Which housing estate had a major SARS cluster?
explanation_zh: 淘大 E 座成為重災區。
explanation_en: Block E became the hotspot.

q_zh: 2003 年 7 月 1 日的大遊行主要反對甚麼？
q_en: What was the main target of the 1 July 2003 march?
explanation_zh: 約 50 萬人參加（主辦單位數字）。
explanation_en: About 500,000 took part, according to organisers.

q_zh: 2003 年遊行後，二十三條立法有何結果？
q_en: What happened to the Article 23 bill after the 2003 march?
wrong2_en: It went to Britain for approval
explanation_zh: 保安局局長葉劉淑儀其後辭職。
explanation_en: Security Secretary Regina Ip later resigned.

q_zh: 2003 年簽署、深化內地與香港經貿的安排叫甚麼？
q_en: What trade arrangement between the mainland and Hong Kong was signed in 2003?
explanation_zh: 同年亦開放自由行。
explanation_en: Individual visits by mainlanders were also opened that year.

q_zh: 董建華 2005 年辭職後，誰接任行政長官？
q_en: Who succeeded Tung Chee-hwa after he resigned in 2005?
explanation_zh: 曾蔭權先完成餘下任期，再於 2007 年連任。
explanation_en: Tsang finished the term and won again in 2007.

q_zh: 香港迪士尼樂園於哪一年開幕？
q_en: In which year did Hong Kong Disneyland open?
explanation_zh: 樂園位於大嶼山。
explanation_en: The park is on Lantau Island.

q_zh: 1999 年人大常委會首次釋法，涉及哪個議題？
q_en: The NPCSC's first interpretation of the Basic Law in 1999 concerned what issue?
explanation_zh: 釋法推翻了終審法院的部分裁決效果。
explanation_en: It overturned part of the effect of a Court of Final Appeal ruling.

q_zh: 2006–07 年保衞天星碼頭與皇后碼頭運動關乎甚麼？
q_en: What was at stake in the 2006–07 Star Ferry and Queen's Pier campaigns?
correct_zh: 集體回憶與歷史建築保育
explanation_zh: 保育意識自此抬頭。
explanation_en: Heritage awareness grew from then on.

q_zh: 2010 年菲律賓人質事件中，多少名香港旅客遇害？
q_en: How many Hong Kong tourists died in the 2010 Manila hostage crisis?
explanation_zh: 事件於 8 月 23 日發生。
explanation_en: It happened on 23 August.

q_zh: 1998 年首屆特區立法會選舉投票率約為多少？
q_en: Roughly what was the turnout in the first SAR LegCo election in 1998?
explanation_zh: 投票率創當時新高。
explanation_en: It was a record at the time.

q_zh: 回歸時，《基本法》於哪天起實施？
q_en: On what date did the Basic Law take effect?
explanation_en: Promulgated 1990, effective 1997.

q_zh: 回歸後特區行政長官任期為多少年？
q_en: How long is a Chief Executive's term?
explanation_zh: 最多可連任一次。
explanation_en: At most two consecutive terms.

q_zh: 《基本法》第二十七條保障哪類自由？
q_en: Which freedoms does Article 27 of the Basic Law protect?
correct_zh: 言論、新聞、出版、集會、結社、遊行示威及罷工
correct_en: Speech, press, publication, assembly, association, procession, demonstration and strike
explanation_zh: 第二十七條是港人自由的核心條文。
explanation_en: Article 27 is the core provision on these freedoms.

q_zh: 《基本法》第三十九條保留了哪些國際人權公約的適用？
q_en: Which international human rights covenants does Article 39 keep in force?
correct_zh: 《公民權利和政治權利國際公約》等
explanation_zh: 兩約適用於香港的規定繼續有效。
explanation_en: Their provisions as applied to Hong Kong remain in force.

q_zh: 《香港人權法案條例》於哪一年制定？
q_en: In which year was the Hong Kong Bill of Rights Ordinance enacted?
explanation_zh: 條例把公民權利公約納入本地法律。
explanation_en: It brought the ICCPR into local law.

q_zh: 「無罪推定」的意思是甚麼？
q_en: What does the 'presumption of innocence' mean?
correct_zh: 被控人在被定罪前視為無罪，控方須舉證
correct_en: A person charged is treated as innocent until proven guilty; the prosecution must prove it
explanation_zh: 《基本法》第八十七條有明文規定。
explanation_en: Article 87 of the Basic Law states it.

q_zh: 終審法院於哪一年成立，取代英國樞密院？
q_en: In which year was the Court of Final Appeal established, replacing the Privy Council?
explanation_zh: 香港保留普通法制度。
explanation_en: Hong Kong retains the common law system.

q_zh: 目前立法會共有多少個議席？
q_en: How many seats does the Legislative Council currently have?
explanation_zh: 2021 年選制改革後由 70 席增至 90 席。
explanation_en: The 2021 electoral overhaul raised it from 70 to 90.

q_zh: 2016 年立法會 70 席中，有多少席由地方選區直選產生？
q_en: Of the 70 seats in the 2016 LegCo, how many were directly elected geographical seats?
explanation_zh: 另外 35 席為功能界別。
explanation_en: The other 35 were functional constituencies.

q_zh: 2021 年改制後，選舉委員會有多少人？
q_en: How many members does the Election Committee have after the 2021 overhaul?
explanation_zh: 選委會負責選行政長官及部分立法會議員。
explanation_en: It chooses the Chief Executive and some lawmakers.

q_zh: 舉行超過 30 人的公眾遊行，一般須向警方作甚麼？
q_en: Holding a public procession of more than 30 people generally requires what from police?
correct_zh: 提前通知警方（不反對通知書）
correct_en: Advance notice to police (a letter of no objection)
explanation_zh: 《公安條例》訂明通知程序。
explanation_en: The Public Order Ordinance sets out the process.

q_zh: 《香港人權法案》如何規定對待被剝奪自由的人？
q_en: How does the Bill of Rights say people deprived of liberty must be treated?
correct_zh: 必須人道及尊重其固有尊嚴
correct_en: With humanity and respect for their inherent dignity
explanation_zh: 所以嘲笑囚犯並不符合法治與文明社會的準則。
explanation_en: Mocking prisoners therefore falls short of the rule of law and basic decency.

q_zh: 《種族歧視條例》大約於哪一年生效？
q_en: In which year did the Race Discrimination Ordinance take effect?
explanation_en: Passed in 2008, in force in 2009.

q_zh: 《性別歧視條例》與《殘疾歧視條例》於哪年制定？
q_en: In which year were the Sex and Disability Discrimination Ordinances enacted?
explanation_zh: 平等機會委員會於 1996 年成立。
explanation_en: The Equal Opportunities Commission followed in 1996.

q_zh: 平等機會委員會於哪一年成立？
q_en: In which year was the Equal Opportunities Commission set up?
explanation_zh: 負責執行反歧視法例。
explanation_en: It enforces the anti-discrimination laws.

q_zh: 申訴專員公署（前身為行政事務投訴專員）於哪一年成立？
q_en: In which year was the Office of The Ombudsman established?
explanation_zh: 1994 年起改稱「申訴專員」。
explanation_en: Renamed the Ombudsman in 1994.

q_zh: 向公務員送「茶錢」以求方便，在香港是否合法？
q_en: Is offering 'tea money' to a public servant for a favour legal in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 廉署為此而設。
explanation_en: The ICAC exists to enforce it.

q_zh: 在香港，被召作陪審員的最低年齡是多少？
q_en: What is the minimum age for jury service in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 須年滿 21 歲至 65 歲。
explanation_en: Jurors must be between 21 and 65.

q_zh: 香港哪個部門向有需要的人提供訴訟資助？
q_en: Which department provides legal assistance to people who need it?
explanation_zh: 確保經濟困難者也有機會上庭。
explanation_en: It helps people of limited means access the courts.

q_zh: 被警方警誡時，下列哪句最貼近你的權利？
q_en: Which statement best reflects your right when cautioned by police?
correct_zh: 你無須回答，但所說的話可能被作為證據
correct_en: You need not say anything, but what you say may be used as evidence
wrong2_en: You may not hire a lawyer
explanation_zh: 這是警誡的標準內容。
explanation_en: That is the standard wording of the caution.

q_zh: 《基本法》第三十二條保障甚麼？
q_en: What does Article 32 of the Basic Law protect?
correct_en: Freedom of conscience and religious belief
explanation_zh: 港人可自由信奉宗教。
explanation_en: Residents are free to follow any faith.

q_zh: 成為香港永久居民，一般須在港通常居住多少年？
q_en: How many years of ordinary residence are generally needed to become a permanent resident?
explanation_zh: 並須符合其他條件。
explanation_en: Other conditions also apply.

q_zh: 2014 年 8 月 31 日人大常委會決定的核心是甚麼？
q_en: What was at the core of the NPCSC's 31 August 2014 decision?
correct_zh: 特首候選人須經提名委員會過半數支持，限於 2 至 3 人
correct_en: Candidates need majority support from a nominating committee, limited to two or three
explanation_zh: 這引發了 2014 年雨傘運動。
explanation_en: It sparked the 2014 Umbrella Movement.

q_zh: 自哪一年起，中文與英文同為香港法定語文？
q_en: From which year have Chinese and English been equal official languages?
explanation_zh: 《法定語文條例》1974 年通過。
explanation_en: The Official Languages Ordinance was passed in 1974.

q_zh: 《基本法》最終解釋權屬於誰？
q_en: Who holds the final power to interpret the Basic Law?
correct_zh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
explanation_zh: 第一百五十八條規定，但法院亦可解釋有關條文。
explanation_en: Article 158 provides this, though Hong Kong courts interpret provisions within their remit.

q_zh: 任何人被捕後，通常須在多少小時內被帶見裁判官或控告／釋放？
q_en: After arrest, within roughly how long must a suspect normally be charged or released (or brought before a magistrate)?
correct_zh: 盡快，實際上通常 48 小時內
correct_en: As soon as practicable — in practice normally within 48 hours
explanation_zh: 依據《人權法案》、警察通則及判例。
explanation_en: Based on the Bill of Rights, Police General Orders and case law.

q_zh: 2005 年 12 月香港舉行了哪場國際會議，引發韓國農民抗議？
q_en: Which international conference in December 2005 drew protests by Korean farmers?
correct_zh: 世界貿易組織部長級會議
explanation_zh: 會議於灣仔會展舉行。
explanation_en: It was held at the Convention Centre in Wan Chai.

q_zh: 2009–10 年反對興建高鐵的運動，圍繞哪條被清拆的村？
q_en: The 2009–10 anti-express-rail campaign centred on which village?
explanation_zh: 年輕人與村民合力抗爭。
explanation_en: Young activists joined villagers.

q_zh: 2010 年「五區公投」為甚麼而發起？
q_en: What was the 2010 'Five Constituencies Referendum' about?
correct_en: Pushing for genuine universal suffrage soon
explanation_zh: 五名議員辭職，以補選當公投。
explanation_en: Five lawmakers resigned to force by-elections.

q_zh: 2012 年政改新增的「區議會（第二）」議席由誰選出？
q_en: Who elected the new 'District Council (Second)' seats added in 2012?
correct_zh: 不屬功能界別的全體選民
correct_en: All voters not in functional constituencies
explanation_zh: 俗稱「超級區議會」。
explanation_en: Nicknamed the 'super seats'.

q_zh: 梁振英 2012 年當選行政長官時，獲得多少票？
q_en: How many votes did C.Y. Leung win in the 2012 Chief Executive election?
explanation_zh: 選舉委員會共 1,200 人。
explanation_en: The Election Committee had 1,200 members.

q_zh: 2012 年大規模遊行反對推行哪項課程？
q_en: In 2012 mass protests opposed which school subject?
explanation_zh: 學民思潮由黃之鋒發起，政府其後擱置科目。
explanation_en: Scholarism, led by Joshua Wong, helped force the government to shelve it.

q_zh: 2012 年南丫島撞船事件造成多少人死亡？
q_en: How many people died in the 2012 Lamma ferry collision?
explanation_zh: 事件於 10 月 1 日國慶夜發生。
explanation_en: It happened on the night of 1 October.

q_zh: 2013 年戴耀廷倡議的行動叫甚麼？
q_en: What action did Benny Tai propose in 2013?
correct_en: Occupy Central with Love and Peace
explanation_zh: 他提出以公民抗命爭取真普選。
explanation_en: He proposed civil disobedience for genuine universal suffrage.

q_zh: 2014 年 6 月的民間公投大約有多少人參與？
q_en: About how many people took part in the June 2014 civil referendum?
explanation_zh: 投票包括網上及票站。
explanation_en: Voting was online and at polling stations.

q_zh: 2014 年 9 月 28 日警方施放了多少枚催淚彈？
q_en: How many tear gas rounds did police fire on 28 September 2014?
explanation_zh: 催淚彈令更多市民走上街頭。
explanation_en: The tear gas brought many more people onto the streets.

q_zh: 「雨傘運動」名稱的由來是甚麼？
q_en: Where did the name 'Umbrella Movement' come from?
correct_zh: 示威者以雨傘抵擋胡椒噴霧與催淚煙
correct_en: Protesters used umbrellas against pepper spray and tear gas
explanation_zh: 黃色雨傘成為象徵。
explanation_en: The yellow umbrella became its symbol.

q_zh: 佔領行動共持續了多少天？
q_en: How many days did the occupation last?
explanation_zh: 由 9 月 28 日至 12 月 15 日。
explanation_en: From 28 September to 15 December.

q_zh: 雨傘運動的主要佔領區不包括下列哪區？
q_en: Which of these was NOT a main occupation site?
explanation_zh: 三個主要佔領區為金鐘、旺角、銅鑼灣。
explanation_en: The three main sites were Admiralty, Mong Kok and Causeway Bay.

q_zh: 以下誰是雨傘運動期間的學生領袖之一？
q_en: Who was among the student leaders during the Umbrella Movement?
explanation_zh: 他是學聯秘書長。
explanation_en: He was secretary-general of the student federation.

q_zh: 金鐘政總外的「連儂牆」是指甚麼？
q_en: What was the 'Lennon Wall' outside the Admiralty government offices?
correct_zh: 貼滿便利貼訊息的樓梯牆
correct_en: A stairwell wall covered with Post-it messages
explanation_zh: 此後各區亦出現連儂牆。
explanation_en: Similar walls later appeared across districts.

q_zh: 2014 年 10 月，與學生代表公開對話的官員是誰？
q_en: Which official led the government side in the televised talks with students in October 2014?
explanation_zh: 對話於 10 月 21 日進行。
explanation_en: The talks took place on 21 October.

q_zh: 2015 年 6 月立法會表決政改方案，結果是？
q_en: What was the result of the June 2015 vote on the reform package?
explanation_zh: 親建制議員大批離場，8 票贊成、28 票反對。
explanation_en: Many pro-establishment members walked out; the vote was 8 for, 28 against.

q_zh: 2015 年「銅鑼灣書店事件」涉及甚麼？
q_en: What did the 2015 Causeway Bay Books incident involve?
correct_zh: 多名書店人員失蹤，後來現身內地
correct_en: Several booksellers disappeared and later surfaced in mainland custody
explanation_zh: 書店售賣內地敏感政治書籍。
explanation_en: The shop sold politically sensitive books about China.

q_zh: 2016 年農曆新年旺角衝突被稱為甚麼？
q_en: What was the Lunar New Year 2016 Mong Kok unrest nicknamed?
explanation_zh: 起因是小販執法。
explanation_en: It began over hawker enforcement.

q_zh: 2016 年宣誓風波中，人大常委會釋明了哪一條？
q_en: Which article did the NPCSC interpret in the 2016 oath-taking row?
explanation_zh: 游蕙禎與梁頌恆其後被取消議員資格。
explanation_en: Yau Wai-ching and Sixtus Leung were then disqualified.

q_zh: 2016–17 年共有多少名立法會議員因宣誓問題被取消資格？
q_en: How many lawmakers were disqualified over oaths in 2016–17?
explanation_zh: 包括羅冠聰、梁國雄、劉小麗、姚松炎。
explanation_en: They included Nathan Law, Leung Kwok-hung, Lau Siu-lai and Edward Yiu.

q_zh: 2017 年林鄭月娥當選特首有何特別之處？
q_en: What was notable about Carrie Lam's 2017 election as Chief Executive?
correct_en: She was the first woman Chief Executive
explanation_zh: 她以 777 票當選。
explanation_en: She won with 777 votes.

q_zh: 2014 年佔領行動中，學生與市民在街頭自發做了甚麼？
q_en: What did people spontaneously do on the occupied streets in 2014?
correct_zh: 設自修室、物資站和回收站
correct_en: Set up study corners, supply stations and recycling points
explanation_zh: 被外媒讚為秩序良好。
explanation_en: Foreign media praised their orderliness.

q_zh: 2014 年的佔領運動最終在哪天結束？
q_en: On what date did the 2014 occupation end?
explanation_zh: 最後一個佔領區銅鑼灣被清場。
explanation_en: The Causeway Bay site was the last cleared.

q_zh: 2019 年修例風波的導火線是哪宗案件？
q_en: Which case triggered the 2019 extradition bill?
correct_zh: 香港男子在台灣涉殺害女友案
correct_en: A Hong Kong man's alleged killing of his girlfriend in Taiwan
explanation_zh: 政府以此為由修訂條例。
explanation_en: The government cited it to justify amending the law.

q_zh: 政府建議修訂哪條條例？
q_en: Which ordinance did the government propose to amend?
explanation_zh: 市民擔心港人可被移交內地受審。
explanation_en: People feared residents could be sent to mainland courts.

q_zh: 2019 年 6 月 9 日遊行，主辦單位宣稱有多少人參與？
q_en: How many people did organisers claim joined the 9 June 2019 march?
explanation_zh: 警方稱高峰時約 24 萬人。
explanation_en: Police said about 240,000 at the peak.

q_zh: 6 月 12 日警方在立法會外使用了甚麼武器？
q_en: What did police use outside LegCo on 12 June?
correct_zh: 催淚彈、橡膠子彈及布袋彈
correct_en: Tear gas, rubber bullets and bean-bag rounds
explanation_zh: 事件引發國際關注。
explanation_en: The scenes drew international attention.

q_zh: 6 月 15 日林鄭月娥宣布對條例草案作何處理？
q_en: What did Carrie Lam announce on 15 June about the bill?
explanation_zh: 市民認為不足夠，要求「撤回」。
explanation_en: Many said suspension was not enough and demanded withdrawal.

q_zh: 6 月 15 日在太古廣場外墮下身亡的人當日穿着甚麼顏色的雨衣？
q_en: What colour raincoat did the man who fell to his death outside Pacific Place on 15 June wear?
explanation_zh: 他被稱為「雨衣人」。
explanation_en: He became known as 'Raincoat Man'.

q_zh: 6 月 16 日遊行市民大多穿甚麼顏色？
q_en: What colour did most marchers wear on 16 June?
explanation_zh: 主辦單位稱約 200 萬人參與。
explanation_en: Organisers claimed about two million.

q_zh: 7 月 1 日示威者衝擊了哪棟建築？
q_en: Which building did protesters storm on 1 July?
explanation_zh: 衝擊事件造成大量破壞。
explanation_en: The storming caused extensive damage.

q_zh: 7 月 21 日晚，白衣人在哪個港鐵站襲擊市民？
q_en: At which MTR station did white-clad men attack people on the night of 21 July?
explanation_zh: 警方遲遲到場，引發強烈批評。
explanation_en: Slow police response drew heavy criticism.

q_zh: 8 月 5 日香港出現了甚麼行動？
q_en: What happened across Hong Kong on 5 August?
explanation_zh: 交通及航班受阻。
explanation_en: Transport and flights were disrupted.

q_zh: 8 月 12 日機場發生了甚麼？
q_en: What happened at the airport on 12 August?
correct_en: Flights were cancelled for the day
explanation_zh: 示威者在大堂集會。
explanation_en: Protesters gathered in the terminal.

q_zh: 8 月 18 日的大集會在哪裏舉行？
q_en: Where was the huge 18 August rally held?
correct_zh: 維多利亞公園及周邊街道
explanation_zh: 當日下大雨，仍有大批市民打傘出席。
explanation_en: Despite heavy rain, a huge crowd turned out with umbrellas.

q_zh: 8 月 23 日的「香港之路」人鏈，靈感來自哪個事件？
q_en: The 23 August 'Hong Kong Way' human chain was inspired by what?
explanation_zh: 市民手牽手連成約 50 公里長的人鏈。
explanation_en: People joined hands in a chain of about 50 km.

q_zh: 8 月 31 日發生警方在哪個港鐵站內的事件？
q_en: In which MTR station did the 31 August incident take place?
explanation_zh: 事件至今仍有爭議。
explanation_en: The incident remains disputed.

q_zh: 9 月 4 日林鄭月娥宣布甚麼？
q_en: What did Carrie Lam announce on 4 September?
explanation_zh: 草案於 10 月 23 日在立法會正式撤回。
explanation_en: It was formally withdrawn in LegCo on 23 October.

q_zh: 10 月 1 日首次有示威者被真槍擊中，他多大年紀？
q_en: How old was the protester first hit by a live round on 1 October?
explanation_zh: 他是一名中學生。
explanation_en: He was a secondary student, Tsang Chi-kin.

q_zh: 10 月 4 日政府引用《緊急情況規例條例》訂立甚麼法例？
q_en: On 4 October the government invoked the Emergency Regulations Ordinance to make what rule?
explanation_zh: 這是自 1967 年後首次動用該條例。
explanation_en: It was the first use since 1967.

q_zh: 以下哪項不是「五大訴求」之一？
q_en: Which of these is NOT one of the 'Five Demands'?
explanation_zh: 五大訴求另含「釋放被捕者」及「落實雙普選」。
explanation_en: The others were releasing arrestees and implementing dual universal suffrage.

q_zh: 「Be water」這句話源自誰？
q_en: Who originated the phrase 'Be water'?
explanation_zh: 運動以流動、分散行動為特色。
explanation_en: The movement favoured fluid, decentralised tactics.

q_zh: 運動期間許多人用哪個本地網上討論區討論？
q_en: Which local online forum did many use during the movement?
explanation_zh: 亦大量使用 Telegram。
explanation_en: Telegram was widely used too.

q_zh: 《願榮光歸香港》是甚麼歌曲？
q_en: What is 'Glory to Hong Kong'?
correct_zh: 2019 年由網友匿名創作的抗爭歌曲
correct_en: A protest song anonymously composed in 2019 by an online user
explanation_zh: 歌曲於 8 月底在網上流傳。
explanation_en: It spread online at the end of August.

q_zh: 9 月 13 日中秋夜，市民在哪座山頭亮起燈光？
q_en: On Mid-Autumn night, 13 September, where did people light up with phone torches?
explanation_zh: 獅子山象徵香港精神。
explanation_en: Lion Rock symbolises Hong Kong spirit.

q_zh: 2019 年 11 月 27 日美國總統簽署了哪項法案？
q_en: Which act did the US President sign on 27 November 2019?
correct_en: The Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act
explanation_zh: 法案引起中方強烈反對。
explanation_en: Beijing strongly objected.

q_zh: 2019 年運動期間，「反送中」的「送中」是指甚麼？
q_en: In the phrase 'anti-extradition' (反送中), what does 'sending to China' (送中) mean?
correct_zh: 把疑犯移交到內地受審
correct_en: Transferring suspects to the mainland for trial
explanation_zh: 這是運動口號的來源。
explanation_en: It is the origin of the slogan.

q_zh: 2019 年 11 月 8 日逝世的科大學生是誰？
q_en: Which HKUST student died on 8 November 2019?
explanation_zh: 他在將軍澳停車場墮下，其後離世。
explanation_en: He fell in a Tseung Kwan O car park and later died.

q_zh: 2019 年 11 月中文大學衝突中，哪座橋是焦點？
q_en: Which bridge was the focus of the November 2019 clashes at CUHK?
explanation_zh: 衝突發生在 11 月 12 日至 15 日。
explanation_en: The clashes ran from 12 to 15 November.

q_zh: 2019 年理工大學圍困大約持續多久？
q_en: About how long did the PolyU siege last in November 2019?
correct_zh: 約兩星期（11 月 17–29 日）
explanation_zh: 大批示威者被捕或離開校園。
explanation_en: Many protesters were arrested or left.

q_zh: 2019 年 11 月區議會選舉投票率約為？
q_en: Roughly what was the turnout of the November 2019 District Council election?
explanation_zh: 創下歷屆新高，逾 290 萬人投票。
explanation_en: A record, with over 2.9 million voting.

q_zh: 該屆區議會選舉中，民主派贏得多少個區議會控制權？
q_en: How many of the 18 District Councils did the pro-democracy camp win?
explanation_zh: 即 18 區中 17 區。
explanation_en: 17 of 18 councils.

q_zh: 《港區國安法》於哪天生效？
q_en: On which date did the Hong Kong National Security Law take effect?
explanation_zh: 當晚 11 時生效。
explanation_en: It took effect at 11pm.

q_zh: 《國安法》訂明的罪行不包括哪項？
q_en: Which is NOT one of the four offences in the National Security Law?
explanation_zh: 第四項為勾結外國勢力。
explanation_en: The fourth is collusion with foreign forces.

q_zh: 《國安法》是經甚麼方式在港實施？
q_en: How was the National Security Law applied in Hong Kong?
correct_zh: 列入《基本法》附件三，繞過立法會
correct_en: Added to Annex III of the Basic Law, bypassing LegCo
wrong1_en: Passed by LegCo in three readings
explanation_zh: 由人大常委會制定。
explanation_en: It was enacted by the NPC Standing Committee.

q_zh: 2020 年 7 月民主派初選約有多少人投票？
q_en: About how many people voted in the July 2020 pro-democracy primary?
explanation_zh: 其後政府指控組織者涉嫌顛覆。
explanation_en: The government later accused organisers of subversion.

q_zh: 2020 年 11 月四名議員被取消資格後，其餘民主派議員作出甚麼行動？
q_en: After four lawmakers were disqualified in November 2020, what did the other pro-democracy lawmakers do?
explanation_zh: 立法會因而剩下親建制議員。
explanation_en: LegCo was then left with pro-establishment members.

q_zh: 2021 年「47 人案」中，有多少人被控串謀顛覆國家政權？
q_en: How many people were charged with conspiracy to commit subversion in the '47' case?
explanation_zh: 他們因 2020 年初選被起訴。
explanation_en: They were charged over the 2020 primary.

q_zh: 2024 年「47 人案」判刑中，戴耀廷被判多少年？
q_en: How long was Benny Tai's sentence in the 2024 '47' case?
explanation_zh: 共 45 人被判囚。
explanation_en: Forty-five people were sentenced.

q_zh: 《蘋果日報》最後一期於何時出版？
q_en: When did Apple Daily publish its final edition?
explanation_zh: 最後一期印了約 100 萬份。
explanation_en: About a million copies were printed.

q_zh: 2021 年 12 月被搜查並停運的網媒是？
q_en: Which online outlet was raided and shut in December 2021?
explanation_zh: 《眾新聞》於 2022 年 1 月也宣布停運。
explanation_en: Citizen News also closed in January 2022.

q_zh: 2021 年 9 月，哪個團體宣布解散？
q_en: Which organisation announced its dissolution in September 2021?
explanation_zh: 它主辦六四燭光晚會多年。
explanation_en: It had organised the June 4 vigil for decades.

q_zh: 2021 年立法會選舉的投票率約為多少？
q_en: Roughly what was the turnout of the December 2021 LegCo election?
explanation_zh: 是回歸後最低。
explanation_en: The lowest since the handover.

q_zh: 2023 年 12 月區議會選舉投票率約為多少？
q_en: Roughly what was the turnout of the December 2023 District Council election?
explanation_zh: 與 2019 年的 71% 對比鮮明。
explanation_en: A stark contrast with 71% in 2019.

q_zh: 2022 年李家超當選特首時有多少名候選人？
q_en: How many candidates were there when John Lee was elected CE in 2022?
explanation_zh: 他是唯一候選人。
explanation_en: He was the sole candidate.

q_zh: 英國 2021 年 1 月 31 日推出了甚麼簽證路線？
q_en: What route did Britain launch on 31 January 2021?
explanation_zh: 持 BN(O) 港人可赴英居留。
explanation_en: BN(O) holders can settle in the UK.

q_zh: 2020 至 2022 年香港人口出現甚麼變化？
q_en: What happened to Hong Kong's population between 2020 and 2022?
correct_zh: 因移民及疫情出現淨流出而下降
correct_en: It fell, with net outflows from emigration
explanation_zh: 許多人移居英國、加拿大、澳洲等地。
explanation_en: Many moved to the UK, Canada, Australia and elsewhere.

q_zh: 2022 年初第五波疫情的主要影響是甚麼？
q_en: What was the main effect of the fifth COVID wave in early 2022?
correct_zh: 醫院不勝負荷，死亡人數大增
correct_en: Hospitals were overwhelmed and deaths soared
explanation_zh: 第五波死亡人數逾九千。
explanation_en: Over 9,000 died in that wave.

q_zh: 2024 年 3 月通過的《維護國家安全條例》俗稱甚麼？
q_en: What is the national security law passed in March 2024 commonly called?
explanation_zh: 條例草案由提交到通過約 11 日。
explanation_en: It went from introduction to passing in about 11 days.

q_zh: 2022 年一場在南韓舉行的欖球賽事，錯誤播放了哪首歌？
q_en: At a 2022 rugby sevens event in South Korea, which song was mistakenly played for Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 事件引起官方交涉。
explanation_en: The incident prompted official complaints.

q_zh: 2020 年 6 月 30 日，國安法的條文是如何公布的？
q_en: How was the National Security Law text published?
correct_zh: 生效前後才公開，期間沒有公眾諮詢
correct_en: Only around the time it took effect, with no public consultation
explanation_zh: 條文約於生效時（晚上 11 時前後）才公布。
explanation_en: The text appeared at about the moment it took effect (around 11pm).

q_zh: 在巴士站見到有人排隊，你應該？
q_en: You arrive at a bus stop where people are queuing. What do you do?
correct_en: Join the back of the queue
wrong3_en: Have a friend save your place at the front
explanation_zh: 「唔好標鬥」是最基本的公德。
explanation_en: Not skipping the queue is the most basic civic courtesy.

q_zh: 有人插隊時，較得體的做法是？
q_en: Someone skips the queue. What is the most decent response?
correct_zh: 有禮地指出隊尾在哪裏
correct_en: Politely point to the back of the queue
explanation_zh: 指出問題，但不必羞辱他人。
explanation_en: Point out the issue without humiliating anyone.

q_zh: 港鐵列車到站，你應該？
q_en: When an MTR train arrives, you should…
wrong3_en: Stand in the doorway on your phone
explanation_zh: 先落後上，人人順暢。
explanation_en: Alight first, board later — it works for everyone.

q_zh: 博愛座最適合誰？
q_en: Who are priority seats for?
correct_zh: 有需要的長者、孕婦、傷殘人士等
correct_en: Elderly, pregnant and disabled passengers who need them
explanation_zh: 見到有需要的人，主動讓座。
explanation_en: Offer your seat when you see someone in need.

q_zh: 在港鐵收費區內飲食，最高罰款是？
q_en: What is the maximum fine for eating or drinking inside the MTR paid area?
explanation_zh: 港鐵附例禁止於付費區飲食。
explanation_en: MTR by-laws prohibit it.

q_zh: 隨地棄置垃圾的定額罰款是多少？
q_en: What is the fixed penalty for littering?
explanation_zh: 違例者可被票控。
explanation_en: Offenders can be ticketed.

q_zh: 在港鐵扶手電梯上，港鐵鼓勵乘客？
q_en: What does the MTR encourage passengers to do on escalators?
correct_en: Stand firm and hold the handrail
explanation_zh: 安全第一。
explanation_en: Safety first.

q_zh: 在車廂內看視頻或講電話，較有禮的做法是？
q_en: In public transport, what is the polite way to watch videos or take calls?
correct_en: Use earphones and keep your voice down
explanation_zh: 別人也要休息。
explanation_en: Others want some peace too.

q_zh: 在茶餐廳與陌生人搭枱，通常是？
q_en: Sharing a table with strangers in a cha chaan teng is…
explanation_zh: 繁忙時段很普遍。
explanation_en: It's common in the lunch rush.

q_zh: 有人為你斟茶，你可以怎樣表示感謝？
q_en: Someone pours you tea. How can you say thanks?
correct_en: Tap two fingers on the table
explanation_zh: 這是飲茶的傳統禮儀。
explanation_en: A traditional yum cha courtesy.

q_zh: 筷子為甚麼不可直插飯中？
q_en: Why should you not stick chopsticks upright in a rice bowl?
correct_zh: 像拜祭先人的香，不吉利
correct_en: It looks like incense at a funeral — bad luck
explanation_zh: 傳統禁忌。
explanation_en: A traditional taboo.

q_zh: 香港餐廳賬單已有 10% 服務費時，一般？
q_en: If a restaurant bill already has a 10% service charge, usually…
explanation_zh: 可視乎服務自行決定。
explanation_en: Add more only if you want to.

q_zh: 為甚麼人們避免送鐘給朋友？
q_en: Why do people avoid giving a clock as a gift?
correct_en: 'Giving a clock' sounds like 'attending a funeral'
explanation_zh: 廣東話諧音禁忌。
explanation_en: A Cantonese pun taboo.

q_zh: 以下哪個數字被視為吉利？
q_en: Which number is considered lucky?
explanation_zh: 「八」諧音「發」，「四」諧音「死」。
explanation_en: 'Eight' sounds like 'prosper'; 'four' sounds like 'death'.

q_zh: 想叫侍應過來，較有禮貌的做法是？
q_en: How do you politely attract a waiter's attention?
correct_en: Raise a hand, make eye contact and say 'm̀h-gōi'
explanation_zh: 尊重服務人員。
explanation_en: Respect service staff.

q_zh: 外籍家庭傭工在香港享有甚麼基本權利？
q_en: What basic right do foreign domestic helpers have in Hong Kong?
correct_zh: 每星期至少一天休息日
correct_en: At least one rest day every week
explanation_zh: 法例保障，應尊重。
explanation_en: Protected by law — and deserving of respect.

q_zh: 每個膠袋徵費多少？
q_en: How much is the plastic bag charge per bag?
explanation_zh: 自 2015 年全面實施。
explanation_en: Fully in force since 2015.

q_zh: 聽到救護車響號駛近，你應該？
q_en: You hear an ambulance siren approaching. What do you do?
wrong2_en: Stop in the middle of the road
explanation_zh: 每秒都可能影響生命。
explanation_en: Every second can matter.

q_zh: 感冒時乘搭公共交通，香港人習慣？
q_en: When you have a cold on public transport, Hong Kong's habit is to…
correct_en: Wear a mask to protect others
explanation_zh: 沙士後成為社會習慣。
explanation_en: A habit that stuck after SARS.

q_zh: 即使某人被判入獄，對待他的得體態度是？
q_en: Even when someone has been jailed — whatever they did — what is the decent attitude?
correct_zh: 給予基本人道尊重，批評其言行而非嘲笑
correct_en: Basic humanity and dignity — criticise ideas, don't mock
explanation_zh: 嘲笑囚犯不是香港價值。
explanation_en: Mocking prisoners is not a Hong Kong value.

q_zh: 收到令人震驚的網上消息，轉發前應先？
q_en: Before sharing a shocking online post, you should first…
explanation_zh: 謠言傷害他人。
explanation_en: Rumours hurt people.

q_zh: 「獅子山精神」通常代表？
q_en: What does the 'Lion Rock Spirit' usually stand for?
correct_zh: 刻苦耐勞、守望相助、靈活應變
correct_en: Hard work, mutual help and adaptability
explanation_zh: 源於 1970 年代的《獅子山下》。
explanation_en: It grew out of the 1970s 'Below the Lion Rock'.

q_zh: 飲茶時，誰先斟茶？
q_en: At yum cha, who pours tea first?
correct_en: Pour for others first, then yourself
wrong3_en: Let the waiter do it all
explanation_zh: 照顧身邊的人。
explanation_en: Look after those beside you.

q_zh: 在公眾場所發現他人跌倒受傷，較得體的做法是？
q_en: You see someone fall and get hurt in public. What is the decent thing to do?
explanation_zh: 守望相助。
explanation_en: Look out for each other.

q_zh: 李小龍的名言「Be water」意思大致是？
q_en: Roughly what does Bruce Lee's 'Be water' mean?
correct_en: Stay flexible and adaptable like water
explanation_zh: 出自李小龍的訪談。
explanation_en: It comes from one of his interviews.

q_zh: 王家衛的哪部電影讓梁朝偉在康城影帝？
q_en: Which Wong Kar-wai film won Tony Leung best actor at Cannes?
explanation_zh: 電影於 2000 年上映。
explanation_en: Released in 2000.

q_zh: 成龍於哪年獲奧斯卡終身成就獎？
q_en: In which year did Jackie Chan receive an honorary Oscar?
explanation_zh: 他是表彰其動作電影生涯。
explanation_en: He was honoured for his career in action cinema.

q_zh: 《無間道》被哪部荷里活電影翻拍？
q_en: Which Hollywood film remade 'Infernal Affairs'?
explanation_zh: 《無間行者》獲奧斯卡最佳影片。
explanation_en: It won the Oscar for Best Picture.

q_zh: 《功夫》（2004）由誰導演並主演？
q_en: Who directed and starred in 'Kung Fu Hustle' (2004)?
explanation_zh: 周星馳「無厘頭」喜劇風靡華人世界。
explanation_en: His slapstick style swept Chinese-speaking audiences.

q_zh: Beyond 的哪首歌是 1993 年的經典？
q_en: Which Beyond song is a 1993 classic?
explanation_zh: 主音黃家駒同年逝世。
explanation_en: Lead singer Wong Ka-kui died the same year.

q_zh: 哪位歌手於 2003 年愚人節逝世？
q_en: Which singer died on April Fools' Day 2003?
explanation_zh: 梅艷芳同年 12 月逝世。
explanation_en: Anita Mui died in December that year.

q_zh: 梅艷芳被稱為？
q_en: Anita Mui is known as…
explanation_zh: 她的演藝與慈善貢獻備受懷念。
explanation_en: Remembered for her music and her charity work.

q_zh: 以下哪位不是「四大天王」之一？
q_en: Who was NOT one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings'?
explanation_zh: 第四位是黎明。
explanation_en: The fourth was Leon Lai.

q_zh: 許冠傑被稱為甚麼歌曲類型的開創者？
q_en: Sam Hui is credited as a pioneer of which genre?
explanation_zh: 《鬼馬雙星》主題曲帶起潮流。
explanation_en: The theme of 'Games Gamblers Play' helped launch the trend.

q_zh: 誰寫了《射鵰英雄傳》並創辦《明報》？
q_en: Who wrote 'The Legend of the Condor Heroes' and founded Ming Pao?
explanation_zh: 《明報》於 1959 年創刊。
explanation_en: Ming Pao was launched in 1959.

q_zh: 西西 1975 年的小說名為？
q_en: What was Xi Xi's 1975 novel called?
explanation_zh: 「我城」成為香港的別稱。
explanation_en: 'My City' became a nickname for Hong Kong.

q_zh: 哪隻卡通小豬是香港著名角色？
q_en: Which cartoon piglet is a famous Hong Kong character?
explanation_zh: 《麥兜故事》以香港人的生活為背景。
explanation_en: The McDull stories are set in everyday Hong Kong life.

q_zh: 《老夫子》漫畫作者是誰？
q_en: Who created the comic 'Old Master Q'?
explanation_zh: 漫畫自 1962 年連載。
explanation_en: Serialised since 1962.

q_zh: 粵劇於哪年列入聯合國非遺名錄？
q_en: In which year was Cantonese opera inscribed on UNESCO's intangible heritage list?
explanation_zh: 粵劇是廣東與香港重要的戲曲。
explanation_en: It is a major art form of Guangdong and Hong Kong.

q_zh: 港式奶茶製作技藝於哪年列入國家級非遺？
q_en: In which year was Hong Kong-style milk tea-making listed as national intangible heritage?
explanation_zh: 「絲襪奶茶」是它的暱稱。
explanation_en: 'Silk-stocking milk tea' is its nickname.

q_zh: M+ 博物館位於哪個區域？
q_en: In which district is the M+ museum located?
explanation_zh: M+ 於 2021 年 11 月開幕。
explanation_en: M+ opened in November 2021.

q_zh: 香港藝術節首辦於哪一年？
q_en: In which year did the Hong Kong Arts Festival begin?
explanation_zh: 藝術節每年於二三月舉行。
explanation_en: It takes place every February–March.

q_zh: 香港電影金像獎首屆是哪一年？
q_en: In which year was the first Hong Kong Film Awards held?
explanation_zh: 被視為「香港的奧斯卡」。
explanation_en: Often called Hong Kong's Oscars.

q_zh: 香港管弦樂團於哪一年成為全職職業樂團？
q_en: In which year did the Hong Kong Philharmonic become fully professional?
explanation_zh: 樂團常駐文化中心。
explanation_en: It is based at the Cultural Centre.

q_zh: 「九龍皇帝」曾灶財以甚麼聞名？
q_en: What was Tsang Tsou-choi, the 'King of Kowloon', famous for?
explanation_zh: 作品現已成為藝術收藏。
explanation_en: His work is now collected as art.

q_zh: Art Basel 在香港舉辦始於哪年？
q_en: In which year did Art Basel begin in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 每年三月舉行。
explanation_en: Held every March.

q_zh: 港式菠蘿包裏面通常有？
q_en: What is usually inside a Hong Kong pineapple bun?
correct_zh: 什麼菠蘿也沒有（只是外形像）
correct_en: No pineapple at all (just the look)
explanation_zh: 配牛油就是「菠蘿油」。
explanation_en: With butter it becomes a 'pineapple bun with butter'.

q_zh: 《重慶森林》的主要場景之一是？
q_en: A key setting of 'Chungking Express' is…
correct_en: Chungking Mansions in Tsim Sha Tsui
explanation_zh: 電影於 1994 年上映。
explanation_en: Released in 1994.

q_zh: 《蘋果日報》由誰創辦？
q_en: Who founded Apple Daily?
explanation_zh: 創刊於 1995 年，2021 年停刊。
explanation_en: Founded in 1995; closed in 2021.

q_zh: 《明報》創刊於哪一年？
q_en: In which year was Ming Pao founded?
explanation_zh: 創辦人包括金庸。
explanation_en: Its founders included Louis Cha (Jin Yong).

q_zh: 《南華早報》創刊於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the South China Morning Post founded?
explanation_zh: 是香港歷史悠久的英文報章。
explanation_en: It is Hong Kong's long-established English-language daily.

q_zh: 無綫電視《歡樂今宵》播出於哪段時期？
q_en: During which years did TVB's 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight' air?
explanation_zh: 是香港電視史上最長壽綜藝節目之一。
explanation_en: One of the longest-running variety shows in Hong Kong TV.

q_zh: 亞洲電視的免費電視牌照於哪年屆滿結束？
q_en: In which year did ATV's free-to-air licence end?
explanation_zh: ViuTV 同年啟播。
explanation_en: ViuTV launched that year.

q_zh: 香港電台（RTHK）的廣播歷史最早可追溯至哪年？
q_en: RTHK's broadcasting history goes back to which year?
explanation_zh: 早期稱為香港廣播電台。
explanation_en: It began as Radio Hong Kong.

q_zh: 連登（LIHKG）論壇於哪年成立？
q_en: In which year was the LIHKG forum launched?
explanation_zh: 2019 年成為重要討論平台。
explanation_en: It became a key platform in 2019.

q_zh: 《星島日報》由哪位「萬金油大王」創辦？
q_en: Which 'Tiger Balm king' founded Sing Tao Daily?
explanation_zh: 創辦於 1938 年。
explanation_en: Founded in 1938.

q_zh: 回歸前，新華社香港分社扮演甚麼角色？
q_en: Before 1997, what role did the Xinhua Hong Kong branch play?
correct_zh: 實際上代表北京的機構
correct_en: A de facto representative office of Beijing
explanation_zh: 後改組為中聯辦。
explanation_en: It later became the Liaison Office.

q_zh: 香港電台《頭條新聞》屬於哪類節目？
q_en: What kind of show was RTHK's 'Headliner'?
explanation_zh: 節目其後停播。
explanation_en: The show was later discontinued.

q_zh: 香港報章在中文傳統中以甚麼聞名？
q_en: Which feature is Hong Kong newspapers known for in the Chinese tradition?
explanation_zh: 金庸小說最初就是報紙連載。
explanation_en: Louis Cha's novels were first serialised in newspapers.

q_zh: 香港首面奧運金牌由誰於 1996 年奪得？
q_en: Who won Hong Kong's first Olympic gold medal in 1996?
explanation_zh: 她在亞特蘭大奧運風帆項目奪金。
explanation_en: She won windsurfing gold in Atlanta.

q_zh: 張家朗在哪個項目奪得奧運金牌？
q_en: In which event did Cheung Ka-long win Olympic gold?
explanation_en: At the Tokyo 2020 Games, held in 2021.

q_zh: 2024 年巴黎奧運，江旻憓在哪個項目奪金？
q_en: At Paris 2024, in which event did Vivian Kong win gold?
explanation_zh: 她是香港第二位擊劍金牌得主。
explanation_en: She is Hong Kong's second fencing gold medallist.

q_zh: 何詩蓓在 2020 東京奧運贏得多少面獎牌？
q_en: How many medals did Siobhan Haughey win at Tokyo 2020?
explanation_zh: 項目為 100 米及 200 米自由泳。
explanation_en: In the 100m and 200m freestyle.

q_zh: 李慧詩在 2012 年倫敦奧運奪得甚麼？
q_en: What did Sarah Lee win at the London 2012 Olympics?
explanation_zh: 她被稱為「單車女王」。
explanation_en: She is nicknamed the 'cycling queen'.

q_zh: 香港國際七人欖球賽首辦於哪一年？
q_en: In which year did the Hong Kong Sevens begin?
explanation_zh: 自 1982 年起在政府大球場舉行。
explanation_en: It has been held at Hong Kong Stadium since 1982.

q_zh: 「五一九事件」是指 1985 年哪項賽事？
q_en: The '5.19 incident' of 1985 refers to which match?
correct_zh: 世界盃外圍賽香港 2:1 勝中國
correct_en: A World Cup qualifier in which Hong Kong beat China 2–1
explanation_zh: 賽後北京球場出現騷動。
explanation_en: Fans rioted at the Beijing stadium afterwards.

q_zh: 端午節香港舉行哪項傳統運動？
q_en: Which traditional sport is held at Tuen Ng in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 赤柱與大澳最著名。
explanation_en: Stanley and Tai O are best known.

q_zh: 香港首次參加奧運是哪一年？
q_en: In which year did Hong Kong first compete at the Olympics?
explanation_zh: 在赫爾辛基奧運。
explanation_en: At the Helsinki Games.

q_zh: 回歸後，香港參加奧運時使用甚麼名稱？
q_en: After 1997 under what name does Hong Kong compete at the Olympics?
explanation_zh: 香港仍以獨立單位參賽。
explanation_en: Hong Kong still competes as a separate team.

q_zh: 香港在哪一年主辦東亞運動會？
q_en: In which year did Hong Kong host the East Asian Games?
explanation_zh: 東亞運於 2009 年 12 月舉行。
explanation_en: Held in December 2009.

q_zh: 賽馬會舉辦的「六合彩」始於哪年？
q_en: In which year did the Mark Six lottery start?
explanation_zh: 由香港賽馬會營運。
explanation_en: Operated by the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

q_zh: 香港賽馬會成立於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the Hong Kong Jockey Club founded?
explanation_zh: 現為主要慈善捐款機構之一。
explanation_en: Today also a major charity donor.

q_zh: 農曆新年派利是，通常由誰派給誰？
q_en: At Lunar New Year, who usually gives lai see to whom?
correct_zh: 已婚人士派給未婚者及晚輩
correct_en: Married people give to unmarried people and children
explanation_zh: 也會派給管理員等服務人員。
explanation_en: Also given to building staff and service workers.

q_zh: 農曆新年公眾假期通常有多少天？
q_en: How many days is the Lunar New Year public holiday usually?
explanation_zh: 初一至初三。
explanation_en: Days one to three.

q_zh: 農曆新年煙花匯演通常在哪晚舉行？
q_en: On which night is the Lunar New Year fireworks display usually held?
correct_en: The evening of the second day
explanation_zh: 在維港兩岸觀賞。
explanation_en: Watched on both sides of the harbour.

q_zh: 清明節的主要習俗是？
q_en: What is the main custom of Ching Ming?
explanation_zh: 多在 4 月初。
explanation_en: Usually in early April.

q_zh: 重陽節的傳統活動是？
q_en: A traditional Chung Yeung activity is…
correct_en: Hiking up hills and honouring ancestors
explanation_zh: 在農曆九月初九。
explanation_en: On the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.

q_zh: 端午節紀念哪位詩人？
q_en: Which poet is commemorated at Tuen Ng?
explanation_zh: 吃糉子與賽龍舟。
explanation_en: People eat zongzi and race dragon boats.

q_zh: 中秋節翌日是否公眾假期？
q_en: Is the day after Mid-Autumn a public holiday?
explanation_zh: 中秋當日本身不是假期。
explanation_en: Mid-Autumn day itself is not.

q_zh: 長洲太平清醮最著名的是？
q_en: What is the Cheung Chau Bun Festival best known for?
explanation_zh: 1978 年包山倒塌後一度停辦，2005 年恢復搶包山。
explanation_en: After a 1978 collapse, bun scrambling was suspended and revived in 2005.

q_zh: 盂蘭節在農曆哪個月？
q_en: In which lunar month is the Hungry Ghost Festival?
explanation_zh: 有燒衣紙、搭神棚的習俗。
explanation_en: People burn offerings and build bamboo theatres.

q_zh: 冬至在港人心中常被稱為？
q_en: How is Winter Solstice often described by Hongkongers?
correct_en: 'Winter solstice is bigger than the New Year'
explanation_zh: 很多家庭會團聚吃飯。
explanation_en: Many families gather for a meal.

q_zh: 天后誕主要供奉哪位神明？
q_en: Which deity is honoured at the Tin Hau Festival?
correct_en: Tin Hau, goddess of the sea
explanation_zh: 漁民及沿海居民尤為重視。
explanation_en: Fishers and coastal communities treasure it.

q_zh: 佛誕自哪年起成為香港公眾假期？
q_en: From which year has Buddha's Birthday been a Hong Kong public holiday?
explanation_zh: 回歸後新增的假期。
explanation_en: A holiday added after the handover.

q_zh: 7 月 1 日是甚麼假期？
q_en: What is the 1 July public holiday?
correct_zh: 香港特別行政區成立紀念日
explanation_zh: 亦是 2003 年大遊行的日子。
explanation_en: Also the date of the 2003 march.

q_zh: 10 月 1 日是甚麼假期？
q_en: What is the 1 October holiday?
explanation_zh: 香港亦有煙花匯演。
explanation_en: There is usually a fireworks show.

q_zh: 香港每年一般有多少天公眾假期？
q_en: How many general public holidays does Hong Kong have in a year?
explanation_zh: 政府訂明的「公眾假期」。
explanation_en: The government-designated 'general holidays'.

q_zh: 聖誕節翌日香港稱為？
q_en: What is the day after Christmas called in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 與聖誕同是公眾假期。
explanation_en: Also a public holiday.

q_zh: 復活節期間香港有哪三天假期？
q_en: Which three Easter days are public holidays in Hong Kong?
correct_zh: 耶穌受難節、翌日及復活節星期一
correct_en: Good Friday, the following day and Easter Monday
explanation_zh: 與英國殖民歷史有關。
explanation_en: A legacy of British rule.

q_zh: 勞動節是哪一天？
q_en: On which date is Labour Day?
explanation_zh: 全球勞工節日。
explanation_en: An international workers' day.

q_zh: 維港每晚的「幻彩詠香江」大約在何時舉行？
q_en: At about what time is the nightly 'Symphony of Lights' show?
explanation_zh: 2004 年起每晚上演。
explanation_en: Shown nightly since 2004.

q_zh: 大坑舞火龍在哪個節日舉行？
q_en: At which festival is the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance held?
explanation_zh: 連續三晚舉行，已列入國家級非遺。
explanation_en: Held for three nights, and listed as national intangible heritage.

q_zh: 「盆菜」是哪類地方的傳統宴席？
q_en: 'Poon choi' is a traditional feast of which communities?
correct_en: Walled villages in the New Territories
explanation_zh: 多層食材疊在一個大盆裏。
explanation_en: Layers of ingredients are piled in one big basin.

q_zh: 新年常見的賀年糕點是？
q_en: A common Lunar New Year pastry is…
correct_en: Turnip cake and sticky rice cake
explanation_zh: 寓意步步高升。
explanation_en: Symbolising rising fortunes.

q_zh: 回歸前有哪個假期後來被取消？
q_en: Which pre-1997 holiday was dropped after the handover?
explanation_zh: 「重光紀念日」也已取消。
explanation_en: Liberation Day was dropped too.

q_zh: 元宵節是農曆哪一天？
q_en: On which lunar date is the Lantern Festival?
correct_en: The 15th day of the first lunar month
explanation_zh: 標誌着新年慶祝結束。
explanation_en: It marks the end of New Year celebrations.

q_zh: 香港中學文憑試（DSE）首次舉行於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the HKDSE first held?
explanation_zh: 新學制「三三四」取代舊制會考與高考。
explanation_en: The '3+3+4' system replaced the old HKCEE and A-levels.

q_zh: 香港提供多少年免費基礎教育？
q_en: How many years of free basic education does Hong Kong provide?
explanation_zh: 2008/09 學年起由九年增至十二年。
explanation_en: Extended from nine to twelve years from 2008/09.

q_zh: 九年免費強迫教育始於哪年？
q_en: When did nine years of free, compulsory education start?
explanation_zh: 初中三年強迫入學。
explanation_en: Including three compulsory junior secondary years.

q_zh: 香港中文大學成立於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the Chinese University of Hong Kong founded?
explanation_zh: 由新亞、崇基、聯合組成。
explanation_en: Formed from New Asia, Chung Chi and United colleges.

q_zh: 香港科技大學成立於哪年？
q_en: In which year was HKUST founded?
explanation_zh: 位於清水灣。
explanation_en: It is located in Clear Water Bay.

q_zh: 本地學生透過哪個機制以 DSE 成績申請大學？
q_en: Which system do local students use to apply to universities with DSE results?
explanation_zh: JUPAS 為統一申請平台。
explanation_en: JUPAS is a unified application platform.

q_zh: 哪年起推行幼稚園教育計劃，資助幼稚園學費？
q_en: From which year did the Kindergarten Education Scheme subsidise fees?
explanation_zh: 提供免費優質幼稚園教育。
explanation_en: It offers free quality kindergarten places.

q_zh: 1998 年推行「母語教學」的主要目的是？
q_en: What was the aim of the 1998 mother-tongue teaching policy?
correct_zh: 多數中學以中文授課，提升學習效果
correct_en: Most secondary schools teach in Chinese for better learning
explanation_zh: 之後也容許部分學校用英語。
explanation_en: Some schools could keep English instruction.

q_zh: 哪個機構管理香港公立醫院？
q_en: Which body runs Hong Kong's public hospitals?
explanation_en: Established in 1990.

q_zh: 香港緊急求助電話是？
q_en: What is Hong Kong's emergency number?
explanation_zh: 警、消、救護均撥 999。
explanation_en: Police, fire and ambulance via 999.

q_zh: 醫健通／長者醫療券計劃主要補貼誰？
q_en: Who does the Elderly Health Care Voucher Scheme mainly subsidise?
correct_zh: 長者使用私營基層醫療服務
correct_en: Elderly people using private primary care
explanation_zh: 2009 年起試行，後成為恆常計劃。
explanation_en: Piloted from 2009, then made permanent.

q_zh: 香港公共醫療主要由甚麼支持？
q_en: What mainly funds Hong Kong's public healthcare?
explanation_zh: 因此公立醫院收費遠低於私家。
explanation_en: Public fees are far below private ones.

q_zh: 香港人預期壽命屬世界哪個水平？
q_en: How does Hong Kong's life expectancy rank globally?
correct_en: Among the highest in the world
explanation_zh: 男女平均都超過 80 歲。
explanation_en: Both men and women exceed 80 on average.

q_zh: 以下哪項是中醫的正式規管機構？
q_en: Which body regulates Chinese medicine practitioners?
explanation_zh: 1999 年起註冊中醫。
explanation_en: Registration began in 1999.

q_zh: 瑪麗醫院始建於哪年（大約）？
q_en: Roughly when was Queen Mary Hospital built?
explanation_zh: 位於薄扶林。
explanation_en: It is in Pok Fu Lam.

q_zh: 市區的士是甚麼顏色？
q_en: What colour are urban taxis in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 新界為綠色，大嶼山為藍色。
explanation_en: New Territories taxis are green, Lantau's are blue.

q_zh: 哪種交通工具自 1904 年起在港島行駛？
q_en: Which transport has run on Hong Kong Island since 1904?
explanation_zh: 暱稱「叮叮」。
explanation_en: Nicknamed 'Ding Ding'.

q_zh: 大約多少港人住在公共租住房屋？
q_en: Roughly what share of Hongkongers live in public rental housing?
explanation_zh: 公屋由房屋委員會興建。
explanation_en: Public rental flats are built by the Housing Authority.

q_zh: 香港約有多少土地劃為郊野公園？
q_en: About how much of Hong Kong's land is country park?
explanation_zh: 《郊野公園條例》1976 年訂立。
explanation_en: The Country Parks Ordinance dates from 1976.

q_zh: 香港食水大部分來自哪裏？
q_en: Where does most of Hong Kong's fresh water come from?
explanation_zh: 自 1960 年代起供水。
explanation_en: Supplied since the 1960s.

q_zh: 哪個天氣信號通常會令學校停課？
q_en: Which weather warning typically suspends classes?
correct_zh: 八號或以上颱風信號／黑色暴雨
correct_en: Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above / black rainstorm
explanation_zh: 教育局會按情況通知。
explanation_en: The Education Bureau announces arrangements.

q_zh: 2024 年首次文憑試起，取代通識科的是甚麼科目？
q_en: Which subject replaced Liberal Studies, with its first DSE exam in 2024?
