explanation_zh: 科目內容包括國情與國安。
explanation_en: The curriculum includes national conditions and security.

q_zh: 香港小巴有哪兩種顏色？
q_en: Which two colours do Hong Kong minibuses come in?
explanation_zh: 紅色小巴可自由停站，綠色為專線。
explanation_en: Red minibuses stop on demand; green ones run fixed routes.

q_zh: 香港大學是香港最早的大學，位於哪區？
q_en: Where is the University of Hong Kong located?
explanation_zh: 主校園位於港島西。
explanation_en: The main campus is on western Hong Kong Island.

q_zh: 法定最低工資於哪年實施，首次時薪是多少？
q_en: When did the statutory minimum wage start, and at what hourly rate?
explanation_zh: 其後定期檢討調整。
explanation_en: It is reviewed and adjusted periodically.

q_zh: 強積金（MPF）於哪年開始實施？
q_en: In which year did the Mandatory Provident Fund start?
explanation_zh: 僱主與僱員各供款。
explanation_en: Both employer and employee contribute.

q_zh: 強積金供款比率一般是？
q_en: What is the usual MPF contribution rate?
explanation_zh: 每月上限為 1,500 港元。
explanation_en: Capped at HK$1,500 a month.

q_zh: 公務員五天工作周於哪年實施？
q_en: In which year did civil servants begin a five-day week?
explanation_zh: 私營機構情況各異。
explanation_en: Private firms vary.

q_zh: 男性僱員法定侍產假現為多少天？
q_en: How many days of statutory paternity leave do employees get?
explanation_zh: 2015 年起實施。
explanation_en: In force since 2015.

q_zh: 法定產假現為多少星期？
q_en: How many weeks of statutory maternity leave are there?
explanation_zh: 2020 年由十週增至十四週。
explanation_en: Raised from ten to fourteen weeks in 2020.

q_zh: 在職滿一年的僱員，法定有薪年假最少為？
q_en: Minimum paid annual leave after one year's service?
explanation_zh: 年資越長，假期越多，上限 14 天。
explanation_en: Rising with service, up to 14 days.

q_zh: 颱風及暴雨期間，政府鼓勵僱主怎樣做？
q_en: During typhoons and rainstorms, what does the government encourage employers to do?
correct_zh: 制定惡劣天氣上班安排，顧及員工安全
correct_en: Set adverse-weather arrangements that protect staff safety
explanation_zh: 2019 年起有相關《工作守則》。
explanation_en: A Code of Practice has existed since 2019.

q_zh: 港元與美元聯繫匯率的區間約為？
q_en: What is the approximate range of the HK dollar's link to the US dollar?
explanation_zh: 2005 年起設強弱方兌換保證。
explanation_en: Convertibility undertakings have applied since 2005.

q_zh: 以下哪三間銀行發行港幣鈔票？
q_en: Which three banks issue Hong Kong banknotes?
correct_en: HSBC, Standard Chartered and Bank of China (HK)
wrong1_en: Hang Seng, BEA and Dah Sing
explanation_zh: 金管局負責監管。
explanation_en: The HKMA supervises.

q_zh: 金融管理局於哪年成立？
q_en: In which year was the HKMA established?
explanation_zh: 負責貨幣與銀行穩定。
explanation_en: It looks after monetary and banking stability.

q_zh: 恒生指數於哪年開始編制？
q_en: In which year was the Hang Seng Index launched?
explanation_zh: 是香港股市的主要指標。
explanation_en: It is the main benchmark for the stock market.

q_zh: 香港有沒有銷售稅（增值稅）？
q_en: Does Hong Kong have a sales tax (VAT)?
explanation_zh: 香港亦無資本增值稅。
explanation_en: Nor is there a capital gains tax.

q_zh: 香港標準利得稅率（公司）約為多少？
q_en: What is the standard corporate profits tax rate?
explanation_zh: 設兩級制優惠。
explanation_en: There is a concessionary two-tier rate.

q_zh: 公益金創立於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the Community Chest founded?
explanation_zh: 每年舉辦「公益金百萬行」。
explanation_en: It runs the annual 'Walk for Millions'.

q_zh: 「公益金百萬行」自哪年開始？
q_en: From which year has the 'Walk for Millions' been held?
explanation_zh: 市民步行籌款。
explanation_en: People walk to raise funds.

q_zh: 「愛心聖誕大行動」由哪兩個機構合辦？
q_en: Which two organisations run 'Operation Santa Claus'?
correct_en: RTHK and the South China Morning Post
explanation_zh: 自 1988 年起籌款。
explanation_en: Fundraising since 1988.

q_zh: 香港哪個機構是最大慈善捐款機構之一？
q_en: Which organisation is one of Hong Kong's largest charitable donors?
correct_zh: 香港賽馬會慈善信託基金
correct_en: Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust
explanation_zh: 資助教育、醫療與體育。
explanation_en: Funding education, healthcare and sport.

q_zh: 民安隊成立於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the Civil Aid Service founded?
explanation_zh: 是紀律部隊的義務力量。
explanation_en: A volunteer disciplined service.

q_zh: 香港義工運動始於哪年？
q_en: In which year was the Volunteer Movement launched in Hong Kong?
explanation_zh: 推動社會參與。
explanation_en: It promoted community involvement.

q_zh: 國際義工日是哪天？
q_en: When is International Volunteer Day?
explanation_zh: 聯合國訂定。
explanation_en: Designated by the UN.

q_zh: 香港紅十字會的主要服務之一是？
q_en: A main service run by the Hong Kong Red Cross is…
explanation_zh: 市民定期捐血救人。
explanation_en: Residents regularly donate blood to save lives.

q_zh: 颱風後見到街道有倒樹，市民守望相助的做法是？
q_en: After a typhoon, trees block the road. What reflects Hong Kong's mutual-help spirit?
correct_zh: 通報有關部門並協助清理或提醒他人
correct_en: Report it and help clear or warn others
wrong1_en: Take a photo and walk on
explanation_zh: 守望相助是獅子山精神之一。
explanation_en: Helping each other is a core Lion Rock value.

q_zh: 香港居民須在年滿多少歲時登記身份證？
q_en: At what age must Hong Kong residents register for an identity card?
explanation_zh: 11 歲須登記，18 歲換領成人身份證。
explanation_en: Registration at 11; a new card at 18.

q_zh: 「721 唔見人，831 打死人」這句口號中的兩個日期指甚麼？
q_en: What do the dates in the slogan '721 is missing, 831 is killing' refer to?
correct_zh: 7 月 21 日元朗襲擊（警察遲遲未到）與 8 月 31 日太子站事件
correct_en: The 21 July Yuen Long attack (police arrived late) and the 31 August Prince Edward station incident
wrong1_zh: 6 月 12 日立法會衝突與 7 月 1 日
wrong1_en: The 12 June LegCo clash and 1 July
wrong2_zh: 10 月 1 日與 10 月 4 日
wrong3_zh: 8 月 5 日大罷工與 8 月 12 日機場
wrong3_en: The 5 August strike and 12 August airport
explanation_zh: 市民質疑警方在元朗缺席、在太子站濫用武力；有關「死人」的傳言從未獲證實，但政府拒絕公開全部片段，令獨立調查的訴求更強。
explanation_en: People accused police of failing to protect the public in Yuen Long and of excess force at Prince Edward. Rumours of deaths were never confirmed, but the refusal to release all footage strengthened calls for an independent inquiry.

q_zh: 「光復香港，時代革命」由誰在 2016 年新界東補選中帶起？
q_en: Who popularised 'Liberate Hong Kong, revolution of our times' in the 2016 New Territories East by-election?
explanation_zh: 梁天琦以本土派身份參選，其後被取消 2016 年立法會選舉資格；這句口號在 2019 年成為運動的象徵。
explanation_en: Leung stood as a localist, was later barred from the 2016 LegCo election, and the slogan became a symbol of the 2019 movement.

q_zh: 梁天琦在 2018 年因 2016 年旺角衝突被判囚多久？
q_en: How long was Edward Leung Tin-kei sentenced to in 2018 over the 2016 Mong Kok unrest?
explanation_zh: 他被裁定暴動及襲警罪成。判刑被視為當時對示威者最重的刑罰之一。
explanation_en: He was convicted of rioting and assaulting police, among the harshest sentences handed to protesters at the time.

q_zh: 2012 年反國民教育科運動時，黃之鋒大約幾歲？
q_en: About how old was Joshua Wong during the 2012 campaign against national education?
explanation_zh: 他與學民思潮帶領學生反對「洗腦」教育，政府最終收回強制推行時間表。
explanation_en: He and Scholarism led students against 'brainwashing' education until the government dropped the compulsory timetable.

q_zh: 2012 年反對國民教育的市民，常用哪兩個字批評該科？
q_en: Which word did opponents commonly use to describe the 2012 national education curriculum?
explanation_zh: 約十二萬人（主辦單位數字）於 2012 年 9 月圍堵政府總部。
explanation_en: About 120,000 (organisers) surrounded government HQ in September 2012.

q_zh: 2017 年 Netflix 紀錄片《Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower》講述哪位人物？
q_en: Which figure is the subject of the 2017 documentary 'Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower'?
explanation_zh: 紀錄片記錄他由學民思潮至雨傘運動的歷程。
explanation_en: It follows him from Scholarism through the Umbrella Movement.

q_zh: 黎智英除了創辦《蘋果日報》，還創辦了哪個服裝品牌？
q_en: Besides Apple Daily, which clothing brand did Jimmy Lai found?
explanation_zh: 他 1981 年創立佐丹奴，1995 年創辦《蘋果日報》。
explanation_en: He founded Giordano in 1981 and Apple Daily in 1995.

q_zh: 2020 年 8 月，警方以國安法拘捕黎智英時，大約出動多少警員搜查蘋果日報大樓？
q_en: In August 2020, about how many officers searched the Apple Daily building when Jimmy Lai was arrested?
explanation_zh: 大批警員進入新聞室，引發國際對新聞自由的關注。
explanation_en: Officers entered the newsroom, drawing international concern about press freedom.

q_zh: 2021 年 6 月，政府凍結了蘋果日報相關公司多少資產，令報館無法營運？
q_en: In June 2021 the government froze how much of Apple Daily-linked companies' assets, crippling the paper?
explanation_zh: 報館數日後出版最後一期。
explanation_en: The paper published its final issue days later.

q_zh: 梁健輝是誰？
q_en: Who was Leung Kin-fai (梁健輝)?
correct_zh: 2021 年 7 月 1 日在銅鑼灣刺傷警員後身亡的男子
correct_en: The man who stabbed a police officer in Causeway Bay on 1 July 2021 and died
wrong1_zh: 2019 年元朗襲擊的目擊證人
wrong1_en: A witness of the 2019 Yuen Long attack
explanation_zh: 事件後現場出現悼念，成為社會爭議。
explanation_en: Tributes appeared at the site afterwards and the case became a point of public controversy.

q_zh: 2015 年電影《十年》在 2016 年香港電影金像獎獲得甚麼獎項？
q_en: Which award did the 2015 film 'Ten Years' win at the 2016 Hong Kong Film Awards?
explanation_zh: 電影想像 2025 年的香港，頒獎禮在內地沒有直播。
explanation_en: The film imagines Hong Kong in 2025; the awards ceremony was not broadcast in mainland China.

q_zh: 哪部有關 2019 年運動的紀錄片 2021 年在康城影展首映？
q_en: Which documentary about the 2019 movement premiered at Cannes in 2021?
explanation_zh: 導演周冠威；影片未在香港戲院公映。
explanation_en: Directed by Kiwi Chow; it has not been shown in Hong Kong cinemas.

q_zh: 2021 年 10 月修訂的《電影檢查條例》容許當局做甚麼？
q_en: What did the October 2021 amendment to the Film Censorship Ordinance allow authorities to do?
correct_zh: 以危害國家安全為由禁映或撤銷已批准的電影
correct_en: Ban films, or revoke approvals, on national security grounds
explanation_zh: 修例後，電影檢查更趨嚴格。
explanation_en: Film vetting became considerably stricter.

q_zh: 2020 年 7 月，公共圖書館為了「國安審查」下架了哪位社運人士的書？
q_en: In July 2020 public libraries pulled books by which activist for a 'national security review'?
explanation_zh: 同時被下架的還有陳淑莊、陳健民等人的著作。
explanation_en: Books by Tanya Chan and Chan Kin-man, among others, were also pulled.

q_zh: 2015 年在泰國失蹤的銅鑼灣書店股東、瑞典公民是誰？
q_en: Which Swedish-citizen shareholder of Causeway Bay Books vanished from Thailand in 2015?
explanation_zh: 桂民海 2020 年在內地被判囚十年。
explanation_en: Gui was sentenced to ten years in mainland China in 2020.

q_zh: 銅鑼灣書店店長林榮基 2019 年為何逃往台灣？
q_en: Why did Causeway Bay Books' Lam Wing-kee flee to Taiwan in 2019?
correct_zh: 擔心《逃犯條例》修訂後被移交內地
correct_en: Fearing extradition to the mainland under the proposed bill
explanation_zh: 他之後在台北重開書店。
explanation_en: He later reopened the bookshop in Taipei.

q_zh: 2019 年針對政府把示威者稱為「暴徒」的口號是？
q_en: Which 2019 slogan answered the government calling protesters 'rioters'?
explanation_zh: 「撤銷暴動定性」是五大訴求之一。
explanation_en: 'Retract the riot label' was one of the Five Demands.

q_zh: 香港政治用語中，「黃店」是指甚麼？
q_en: In Hong Kong political slang, what is a 'yellow shop' (黃店)?
correct_en: A business that supports the movement
explanation_zh: 相對的是「藍店」（親政府／親警），形成「黃藍經濟圈」。
explanation_en: The opposite is a 'blue shop' (pro-government/police), forming the 'yellow and blue economic circles'.

q_zh: 2020 年 12 月，黃之鋒、周庭、林朗彥因甚麼案件入獄？
q_en: In December 2020, Joshua Wong, Agnes Chow and Ivan Lam were jailed over what?
correct_zh: 2019 年 6 月圍堵警察總部
correct_en: The June 2019 siege of police headquarters
explanation_zh: 周庭被判囚十個月，2021 年出獄。
explanation_en: Chow was sentenced to ten months and released in 2021.

q_zh: 2021 年因舉辦六四晚會被判囚的前支聯會領導層成員兼勞工運動者是誰？
q_en: Which long-time labour activist and former Alliance leader was jailed over the June 4 vigil?
explanation_zh: 李卓人亦被控國安法下的串謀顛覆罪。
explanation_en: Lee also faces a subversion charge under the NSL.

q_zh: 議員「長毛」梁國雄標誌性的穿着是甚麼？
q_en: What was lawmaker 'Long Hair' Leung Kwok-hung's trademark outfit?
correct_zh: 切·格瓦拉頭像 T 恤
explanation_zh: 他在「47 人案」中被判囚六年九個月。
explanation_en: In the '47' case he was sentenced to six years and nine months.

q_zh: 「佔領中環」三位發起人是戴耀廷、陳健民，以及誰？
q_en: The three founders of 'Occupy Central' were Benny Tai, Chan Kin-man and…
explanation_zh: 三人 2019 年被裁定「公眾妨擾」相關罪名成立。
explanation_en: In 2019 the three were convicted of public nuisance-related charges.

q_zh: 2019 年 4 月，「雨傘九子」共有多少人被裁定罪成？
q_en: How many of the 'Umbrella Nine' were convicted in April 2019?
explanation_zh: 他們被控與 2014 年佔領行動有關的公眾妨擾罪。
explanation_en: They were charged with public nuisance offences linked to the 2014 occupation.

q_zh: 2016 年議員宣誓時，游蕙禎與梁頌恆展示了甚麼標語？
q_en: What banner did Yau Wai-ching and Sixtus Leung display at their 2016 oath-taking?
explanation_zh: 人大釋法後兩人被取消議員資格。
explanation_en: After the NPCSC interpretation they were disqualified.

q_zh: 2018 年，哪個政黨成為首個被政府依《社團條例》取締的政黨？
q_en: Which party became the first banned under the Societies Ordinance in 2018?
explanation_zh: 創黨人陳浩天。
explanation_en: Its founder is Andy Chan.

q_zh: 2020 年 8 月，十二名港人乘快艇逃亡台灣，被截獲後被扣押在哪裏？
q_en: After the "Hong Kong 12" were intercepted at sea in August 2020, where were they held?
explanation_zh: 他們多月不獲見律師，後被判囚七個月至三年。
explanation_en: They were denied their own lawyers for months and later jailed for seven months to three years.

q_zh: 2019 年 8 月在深圳被扣押 15 天的前英國駐港領事館職員是誰？
q_en: Which former British consulate employee was detained for 15 days in Shenzhen in August 2019?
explanation_zh: 他其後獲英國庇護。
explanation_en: He was later granted asylum in the UK.

q_zh: 蔡玉玲 2021 年因甚麼被定罪（其後 2023 年終審法院撤銷）？
q_en: What was RTHK producer Bao Choy convicted of in 2021 (quashed by the Court of Final Appeal in 2023)?
correct_zh: 為拍攝元朗襲擊紀錄片查閱車輛登記資料時作失實陳述
correct_en: Making false statements when searching vehicle records for her documentary on the Yuen Long attack
explanation_zh: 紀錄片為《鏗鏘集》「7.21 誰主真相」。
explanation_en: The documentary was 'Hong Kong Connection: 7.21 Who Owns the Truth'.

q_zh: 2021 年首宗國安法罪成者唐英傑，被控的行為與甚麼有關？
q_en: The first person convicted under the NSL, Tong Ying-kit, was charged over riding a motorbike into police while carrying what?
correct_zh: 寫有「光復香港，時代革命」的旗幟
correct_en: A flag reading 'Liberate Hong Kong, revolution of our times'
explanation_zh: 他被判囚九年；法院裁定該口號含分裂國家意思。
explanation_en: He got nine years; the court held the slogan carried a secessionist meaning.

q_zh: 歌手何韻詩在雨傘運動後有甚麼遭遇？
q_en: What happened to singer Denise Ho after she backed the Umbrella Movement?
correct_zh: 被內地封殺，作品及演出受限
correct_en: She was blacklisted on the mainland, restricting her work
explanation_zh: 她多年來在國際上為港人發聲。
explanation_en: She has long spoken for Hongkongers abroad.

q_zh: 「香港眾志」於哪日宣布解散？
q_en: On what day did Demosistō announce its dissolution?
correct_zh: 2020 年 6 月 30 日（國安法生效日）
correct_en: 30 June 2020, the day the NSL took effect
explanation_zh: 黃之鋒、羅冠聰、周庭同日退出。
explanation_en: Joshua Wong, Nathan Law and Agnes Chow left the same day.

q_zh: 2016 年當選、當時最年輕的立法會議員是誰？
q_en: Who, at 23, became the youngest lawmaker in 2016?
explanation_zh: 他其後因宣誓問題被取消資格，2020 年離港。
explanation_en: He was later disqualified over his oath and left Hong Kong in 2020.

q_zh: 2019 年 7 月 21 日元朗站內被襲擊受傷的民主黨議員是誰？
q_en: Which Democratic Party lawmaker was injured in the Yuen Long station attack on 21 July 2019?
explanation_zh: 他其後被廉署起訴，亦為「47 人案」被告之一。
explanation_en: He was later charged by the ICAC and is also one of the '47'.

q_zh: 2019 年運動中，「和理非」是指甚麼？
q_en: In the 2019 movement, what does 'Wo-lei-fei' (和理非) mean?
correct_zh: 和平、理性、非暴力的參與者
explanation_zh: 相對的是「勇武」；兩者分工，提倡「不割席」。
explanation_en: The counterpart is 'Yung-mo' (brave fighters); the two sides pledged 'no severance' (不割席).

q_zh: 運動中「不割席」的意思是？
q_en: What does the movement principle 'no severance' (不割席) mean?
correct_zh: 不批評、不與不同手法的同路人劃清界線
correct_en: Don't cut ties with fellow protesters who use different tactics
explanation_zh: 目的是保持團結。
explanation_en: The aim was to stay united.

q_zh: 2019 年示威者互相稱呼的「手足」是甚麼意思？
q_en: In 2019, what did protesters mean by calling each other 'hand-and-foot' (手足)?
correct_zh: 像兄弟姊妹一樣的同伴
explanation_zh: 詞語強調互相扶持。
explanation_en: The term stresses mutual support.
